Crassula swaziensis醉斜阳 - 千种多肉植物图鉴 - 梦桑阁


  
 Crassula swaziensis醉斜阳
       一切权力属于原英文作者，译者不懂植物学，欢迎指正
转载请注明原作者&译者。原文：ICN
译者：柳下杜拉罕


醉斜阳  SWAZIENSIS Schönland, 1897Section Argyrophylla
Argyrophylla组Synonyms :
异名：
Crassula argyrophylla var. swaziensis  (Schönland) Schönland
Crassula argyrophylla  Diels ex Schönland & Baker fil. (1902) /  C. globularioides ssp. argyrophylla  (Dielsex Schönland & Baker fil.) Tölken (1975) / Crassula swaziensis fa. argyrophylla  (Diels ex Schönland & Baker fil.) R. Fernandes (1978)
Crassula argyrophylla var. ramosa  Schönland (1929)
C. swaziensis fa. brevipilosa  R. Fernandes (1978)
C. swaziensis ssp. brachycarpa  R. Fernandes (1978)
C. swaziensis var. guruensis  R. Fernandes (1978).Distribution and ecology
分布及生态Growing usually in rock crevices often in exposed positions, from northern Zimbabwe through the mountainous parts of Transvaal, eastern Swaziland and adjoining northern Natal.
通常生长在裸露的岩石缝中，从北部的津巴布韦经过德兰士瓦多山地区，斯威士兰东部和毗邻的北纳塔尔。Short description (based on Tölken)
简短描述（基于Tölken）Perennial plants with short erect or decumbent branches up to 25 cm long, slightly woody, with terminal leaf rosettes.
多年生植物，枝条短直立或外倾，长25厘米，稍木质，终端叶莲座状。Leaves : 2 – 5 (-7) cm long, obovate, rarely oblanceolate, usually rounded, dorsiventrally compressed and slightly convex on both sides, covered with spreading hairs, rarely glabrous, marginal cilia becoming shorter towards leaf base; colour green, grey-green to greyish brown; old leaves persistent.
叶：2-5（-7）厘米，倒卵形，很少倒披针形，通常为圆形，背面扁，两侧稍凸，被平展的毛，很少无毛，边缘纤毛变短于叶基部；绿色，灰绿色至灰褐色；老叶持久不落。Inflorescence : a terminal flat-topped thyrse with a number of dense dichasia; peduncle (2-) 4 – 10 (-12) cm long; bracts shortly oblong–triangular, apex rounded.
花序：终端平顶聚伞圆锥花序及大量密集的聚伞花序；花序梗（2）4-10（-12）厘米；苞片短椭圆形至三角形，先端圆形。Flowers : almost sessile; corolla tubular; sepals 1,5 – 2,5 mm long, oblong-triangular, usually bluntly acute, glabrous or covered with spreading hairs and/or marginal cilia, fleshy, green; petals 3 – 5 mm long, oblong to oblong-oblanceolate, acute, with more or less distinct dorsal appendage, tips recurved, white, becoming cream, often tinged pink in bud; anthers yellow to brown.
花：近无柄；花冠管状；萼片1.5-2,5毫米长，长圆状三角形，通常具钝尖，具平展的毛和或边缘纤毛，肉质，绿色无毛或被毛；花瓣3–长5毫米，长圆形到长圆状披针形，急尖，具有更多或更少的不同的背附属物，顶部下弯，白色，成为霜状，花蕾通常微染粉色，花药黄色到棕色。

Dudleya edulis 仙人宴 - 千种多肉植物图鉴 - 梦桑阁


  
 Dudleya edulis 仙人宴
           种名edulis 意思是"可食用的"，当地印第安原住民有采集此种仙女杯的叶子作为蔬菜食用的传统。顺便一提本人已经试吃过了……味道不咋地酸不溜的，大概是晚上积累了景天酸的缘故，建议就不要试吃，只观赏它好了。
    在国内某宝上购买"棒叶仙女杯"也可能得到此种。因棒叶形态仙女杯品种甚众（仙女棒亚属），笼统概以棒叶之名实有不妥。拟定中文名时选取属名的通译"仙女杯"和"可食用的"，引申后取"仙人宴"，拟为中文名。原文：ICN 仙女杯属 原始种edulis词条
翻译：种花小医杂家赵一切权利属于英文原作者，转载请注明原文链接和译者。欢迎勘误。EDULIS (Nuttall) Moran, 1943
仙人宴 ，由Moran发表于1943年
(译者注：Nuttall为原定名人。由于历史原因，仙女杯属的物种曾经被归于景天属，银波锦属，拟石莲属中，较后才由Britton 和 Rose两人提升为独立属，命名法则规定，属名变更后较初定名人标记于括号内 thx秋涵)Synonyms :
异名：Sedum edule  Nuttall (1840) 较初的定名 错归入景天属
Cotyledon edulis  (Nuttall) Brewer (1876)  错归入银波锦属
Stylophyllum edule  (Nuttall) Britton & Rose (1903) 即仙女棒属 B&R提出的新属  后被合并入仙女杯属中作为亚属
Echeveria edulis  (Nuttall) Purpus ex A.Berger (1930) 错归入拟石莲属Subgenus Stylophyllum
仙女棒亚属Distribution: USA (California: Peninsular Ranges, South Coast), Mexico (North Baja California); rocky slopes, 10 - 750 (-1300) m.
分布：美国（加利福尼亚：半岛山脉，南海岸），墨西哥（下加利福尼亚半岛北部）；生境为岩石坡地，海拔10－750（可达1300米）米范围分布。Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :
形态描述（根据2003年IHSP）:Stems mostly erect and short, 1 - 4.5 cm in diameter.
茎大部分情况下直立且很短，直径1到4.5厘米。Rosettes 5 - 10 (-20) cm in diameter, with ± 10 - 25 leaves, branched and forming cushions up to 50 cm in diameter.
莲座直径5到10（可达20）厘米，叶10片上下到25片， 分枝蔓延成可达50厘米直径的垫状植株。Leaves densely arranged, linear, ± cylindrical except the base, very acute to acutish, 5 - .20 (-40) x 0.3 - 1 (basally 1.5 - 3) cm, pale green, somewhat glaucous but not farinose.
叶密集排列，线型，大致呈圆柱体形态（基部除外），非常尖锐到急尖 ， 5 - .20 （ -40 ）长0.3 - 1 （基部1.5 - 3 ）厘米宽，淡绿色，叶表面仅稍有白霜，达不到厚粉状。Inflorescence : Scape 20 - 50 (-70) cm, inflorescence open, elongate, with several (rarely only 2 - 3) 1 - 2x branched spreading scorpioid branches, these 4 - 10 cm, with 3 - 11 flowers, pedicels 0 - 2 mm.
花序：花葶20 - 50 （ -70 ）厘米长，花序多分散、细长，由多分枝蔓延（罕见2 - 3分支 ）的单体或双分枝蝎尾状花序组成 ，分支长4 - 10厘米，着生3 - 11朵花，花梗0 - 2毫米长。Flowers sometimes slightly scented, calyx 4 - 5 mm, sepals oblong-ovate, acute, usually 2.5 - 4.5 mm, the erect part often overtopping the corolla, petals oblong-lanceolate, apically broadly spreading or ± recurved, acute or mucronate, 7 - 10 x 2 - 3 mm, white, tube 1 - 2 mm, anthers red.
花有时略带香味，花萼4 - 5毫米长，苞片呈长圆状卵形，急尖，通常2.5 - 4.5毫米，直立部分通常超过花冠，花瓣长圆状披针形，花冠顶部平展或略有些下弯，锐尖或短尖，7～10毫米长×2 - 3毫米宽，花瓣白色，花管1 - 2毫米，花药红色。Flowering time : May to July.
花期：五月到七月Cytology : n = 17
染色体数：n=17条A very well-distinguished species, recognizable by pale or light green (not glaucous) terete leaves, open inflorescences with usually several branches, divaricate to somewhat recurved narrow white petals, and divaricate fruits, see Moran (1951a) and Moran (1992a). Natural hybrids are known with D. attenuata ssp. orcuttii, D. blochmaniae ssp. blochmaniae and ssp. brevifolia, D. formosa and D. stolonifera (Moran 1951b).
一个很有特色的物种，浅绿或亮绿色的无霜圆柱形叶片很有辨识度。展开的分枝型花序，平展有时后翘的白色窄细花瓣，和分离的（蓇葖）果。可参见 Moran (1951a)和 Moran (1992a)（的描述？）。和 D. attenuata ssp. orcuttii,D. blochmaniae ssp. blochmaniae 和 ssp. brevifolia，D. formosa 和 D. stolonifera等品种有已知的自然杂交种存在。

 Dudleya farinosa 火焰杯
       原文节选自http://www.crassulaceae.ch/index.php?TPL=10120&x270_id=2584
翻译 种花小医杂家赵FARINOSA (Lindley) Britton & Rose, 1903曾用名：
Echeveria farinosa  Lindley (1849) / Cotyledon farinosa  (Lindley) Baker (1869)
Echeveria farinulenta  Lemaire (1864)
Dudleya compacta  Rose (1903) / Cotyledon compacta  (Rose) Fedde (1904) / Echeveria compacta  (Rose) A. Berger (1930)
Dudleya eastwoodiae  Rose (1903) / Cotyledon eastwoodiae  (Rose) Fedde (1904) / Echeveria eastwoodiae  (Rose) A. Berger (1930)
Dudleya septentrionalis  Rose (1903) / Cotyledon septentrionalis  (Rose) Fedde (1904) / Echeveria septentrionalis  (Rose) A. Berger (1930)Subgenus Dudleya ——仙女杯亚属形态描述（根据 IHSP，2003）：茎干：修长，直径约1 - 3厘米。植株：单个莲座的直径约有4 到10厘米，约有15 - 30片叶。常常呈多分枝群生生长。叶片：呈长卵圆形，叶片前端尖锐。叶片的中部常有一条明显的脊线，脊线在叶片正面和背面都存在。叶片长约2.5 -6厘米，宽约1 - 2.5厘米。叶片分两种形态：被厚粉的、或完全无粉呈现出绿色
【根据这种区别有资料把farinosa分为两种 即Dudleya farinosa（带粉个体）和Dudleya farinosa "green form"（不带粉个体）】。花序：花葶长约10 - 35厘米，花在花序上分布密集，在顶端集中开花。花序直径4 到8厘米，常独生。有时单个花序上会产生三到五个稍细的（1 - 3.5厘米）蝎尾形分支。分支后每个花序3 - 11朵花，单花的花梗长1 - 3（-5）毫米。花：花萼直径5 ​​- 8毫米，单个萼片三角状卵形，尖锐，3 - 7毫米长。花瓣倒披针形，花瓣是互相分离的（仙女杯亚属的特征哦~），花瓣长10 - 14毫米，宽3 - 5毫米，淡黄色，花管（原文"tube"不会翻译了…）长1 - 2毫米，花瓣尖端尖锐，逐渐过渡到钝圆。细胞学检查：染色体数= 17常常与D. pulverulenta（仙女杯"雪山"）形成自然杂交后代。英文版原文摘录如下，欢迎勘误：Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :Stems often elongate, 1 – 3 cm in diameter.Rosettes 4 – 10 cm in diameter, with 15 – 30 leaves, mostly much-branched.Leaves oblong-ovate, apically acute, usually with a clear keel ± in the middle and smaller keels on either side, 2.5 – 6 x 1 – 2.5 cm, strongly farinose or green.Inflorescences : Scape 10 – 35 cm, inflorescences usually rather dense, flat-topped, 4 – 8 cm in diameter, with 3 – 5 not or 1x branched scorpioid branches, these 1 – 3.5 cm, with 3 – 11 flowers, pedicels 1 – 3 (-5) mm.Flowers : Calyx 5 – 8 mm, sepals triangular-ovate, acute, 3 – 7 mm, petals oblanceolate, mostly not touching each other laterally, 10 – 14 x 3 – 5 mm, pale yellow, tube 1 – 2 mm, lobes apically sometimes ± spreading, acute to obtuse.Cytology : n = 17Forms natural hybrids with D. pulverulenta.
Thompson's "septentrionalis" form (汤普逊的"北方"种)

 E. calderoniae 狂刃
       原文：http://www.crassulaceae.ch/index.php?TPL=113&x270_id=1134&x270_listsearch=1
图文：ICN & Flickr
（一切权利归原作者 \ 转载请注明出处）（译注：原拉丁名calderoniae为"刺猬"之意。此莲株形独特，与其他E属或端庄、或奇崛、或古朴的外形有很大区别，而呈现一种矫健灵动、桀骜不驯的美；结合其株形、叶形和拉丁种名发音，拟名"狂刃"。另：此种在欧洲引种较早，栽培者也不少，但未有其任何变种或交配种的记录可查，这对E属算是比较有趣的现象）CALDERONIAE Pérez-Calix, 1997
由植物学家Pérez-Calix在1997年命名Series Secundae \ 七福神系Distribution :  Mexico (Guanajuato)
分布：墨西哥（瓜纳华托州）Description \ 描述 (according \ 根据 to IHSP 2003) :
Stem nearly lacking, branching. Rosette ± 12 cm in diameter. Leaves 20 – 30, lanceolate to narrow - oblongate, acute, with a reddish mucro, 2 – 6 x 0.5 – 0.9 cm wide in the middle, 2 – 4 mm thick, green, reddish in age. Inflorescence a cincinnus 6 – 12 cm long, pedicels 3 – 9 mm. Flowers : Sepals ascending, 3.5 – 10 mm, corolla 8 – 12 mm, 3 – 6 mm in diameter at base, reddish or orange below, yellow above.
近乎无茎，多分生。莲座直径 ±12厘米。叶量 20 - 30片，披针形至狭长圆形，远端急尖，叶尖微红；叶长2 - 6厘米 x 宽0.5 - 0.9厘米，中部稍宽，厚2 - 4毫米；叶色绿，随成株略变红。倒蝎尾花序，6 - 13厘米；花梗长3 - 9毫米。花：萼片立生，3.5 - 10mm，花冠8 - 12毫米，基部径宽3 - 6毫米；红红色，或基部橙色+上部黄色。

 E. cante 广寒宫
       Echeveria cante 广寒宫原文：http://crassulaceae.ch/index.php?TPL=10122&x270_id=1189
翻译：Qiuhan
转载请注明原文链接和译者。译者不懂植物学，欢迎勘误。CANTE Glass & Mendoza-Garcia, 1997
广寒宫，由Glass和Mendoza-Garcia发表于1997年
Series Gibbiflorae
Gibbiflorae系
Distribution : Mexico (Zacatecas)
分布于墨西哥的萨卡特卡斯州
Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :
描述（根据2003年的IHSP）：
Stems to 10 cm tall, 2 – 3 cm in diameter, not branching.
茎部：能长到10cm高，2-3厘米直径，不分枝。
Rosette to 40 cm in diameter
莲座：约40cm直径。
Leaves oblong-obovate, acute, to 18,5 x 7,2 cm, 6 mm thick, upper face flat to concave, thickly white-pruinose, sometimes tinged lavender, margin reddish.

Inflorescences 1 or 2, all parts pruinose, cymose-paniculate, 45 – 60 cm, ±1 cm in diameter near the base, branches ± 5, each with 4 – 12 flowers, pedicels 2 – 7 (-17) mm, to 4 mm in diameter.

以下原文来自 International Crassulaceae Network
作者 International Crassulaceae Network（引言）& J. C. 范柯培尔（描述）
翻译 horse2000引言A somatic mutant of E. 'Metallica' – NOT E. gibbiflora 'Metallica' !
它是拟石莲花属 \ 铁石莲花的变种，而不是拟石莲花属 \ 粉叶莲的变种！Origin unknown, introduced by Mrs. V. Debergue and Sons, Cambrai, Northern France.
由法国北部康布雷镇的"冯•德柏尔克女士母子公司"(园艺公司)引进。原产地不详。First published with a short description by Emile Rodigas in : L'illustration Horticole 30 : 185, p. 505, 1883.
此品种首次见诸书端，是在1883年埃米尔•罗迪格斯所绘并出版的《园艺插图》，第505页。Distributed in UK under the wrong name "E. 'Meynenii' by J. C. van Keppel.
在英国以"拟石莲属 \ 美奈霓"的误名广泛引种描述Habit caulescent.
形态 地上茎。

Stem 20 – 60 cm long in older plants, 20 – 30 mm thick, erect, with a dense rosette on top.
茎干 成年株拥有20 - 60厘米长的直立茎干，径宽20 - 30毫米，密集的莲座于顶端着生。Rosette 10 – 20 cm in diameter.
莲座  直径10 – 20厘米Leaves fleshy, 10 – 15mm thick, erect, later spreading, obovate, 4 – 10 cm long, 2 – 5 cm broad, margins irregular, most whitish or pinkish, apiculate, underside convex, upper side often deeply channeled, colour marbled green, whitish and pinkish, sometimes striped.
叶片 肉质，10 – 15毫米厚，先直立，而后外展，倒卵形，4 - 10厘米长，2 - 5 cm宽；叶外缘不规则，颜色大多数泛白或粉红，叶端具细尖；叶面底部凸，上部常深内凹，叶片大理石绿色为主，夹杂白色和粉红色，常具拉丝锦纹。

Inflorescences 20 – 40 cm long, 1 – 1.5 cm thick, often marbled, at first spreading, later erect, bracts many in a loose rosette, smaller than in the main rosette but of the same colour; flowers in a raceme of short cincinni with 1 – 5 flowers each, pedicels short.
花序 花茎20 - 40厘米长，1 - 1.5厘米厚，大理石纹路，先外展，而后直立，若干苞片着生在一个小型松散莲座中，此花茎莲座较主叶面莲座小，但颜色一致；短蝎尾花序，为1 - 5朵构成，花梗短。

Flowers : Sepals unequal, widespreading at anthesis, 3 – 10 mm long, shining reddish before flowering, later variegated, corolla pinkish outside, yellowish inside, 10 mm long and wide, tips not strong, curving outwards, stigmas reddish, anthers sterile.
花 萼片不平，花期向后打开，3 - 10毫米长，开花前带有醒目的红色，而后变为杂色；花冠外呈粉红，内为黄色，长10毫米，宽，瓣尖较薄，向外微翻，柱头微红色，花药不育。

The parents are the same as for Echeveria 'Lola' but the mother plant for 'Lola' is Echeveria lilacina.
E. 'Derenceana' and E. 'Lola' are fairly similar. Differences in young plants often are not distinct, and the flowers of both hybrids are the same. Older plants can be distinguished because of their size - the rosette of E. 'Lola' is larger and more open than that of E. 'Derenceana'.

茎长10厘米或以上，分枝较松散。Leaves subrosulate, oblong-oblanceolate to obovate-cuneate, mucronate, acute or shortly acuminate, ± 5- 1,5 cm, green, lower face, edges and keel reddish.
叶近乎排列为莲座型，倒披针形长圆形或倒卵形楔形叶片，具短尖，锐尖或短渐尖，±5厘米长 1.5厘米宽，叶片绿色，叶片下表面、叶边缘和叶中脊线红色。Inflorescences irregularly cymose-paniculate, to 25 cm long, lower branches few, short, each with 2 – 6 flowers, pedicels to 1 cm or more.
花序：圆锥状不规则，长25厘米，下部分枝少，短，每个花序2–6花，花梗1厘米或更长一些。Flowers: Sepals strongly ascending to appressed, longest 4 – 5 mm, corolla globose-urceolate, pentagonal, to 10 x 8 mm in diameter, petals apiculate, orange -red.
花：萼片紧密贴合在花上，较长约4-5毫米，花冠球瓮形，（正面观）五边形，10×8毫米直径，花瓣尖细，橘红色。Cytology : n= 42
细胞学检查：染色体数=42Note :
注释-        Whether Fig. 144 and 145 in Pilbeam's book " Echeveria" show the correct plant is rather doubtful.
          Pilbeam的著作《拟石莲属》中的图144和145是否是正确的图示非常可疑。-        And the 2 photos by Julia Etter & Martin Kristen of a plant in cultivation show X Cremneria ′Expatriata′:

 E.leucotricha 白兔耳及其杂交种
       写在较前面的话：
因为名字的关系，这个品种长期和月兔耳 千兔耳 黑兔耳 福兔耳 火星兔子等品种混杂，但其实白兔耳是拟石莲属的植物 ，月兔耳 黑兔耳等品种是伽蓝菜属植物，火星兔子是青锁龙属的。原文：http://www.crassulaceae.ch/index.php?TPL=113&x270_id=1431&x270_listsearch=1

拟石莲系Distribution: Mexico (Puebla: Cerro del Castillo, Caltepec)
分布地：墨西哥 (Puebla: Cerro del Castillo, Caltepec)Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :
形态描述（根据IHSP 2003版）：Stem to 15 cm tall or more, 12 – 15 cm in diameter.
茎干：高15厘米以上，（单个莲座）约有12 - 15厘米直径。Leaves laxly subrosulate, oblong-oblanceolate, obtuse, mucronate, 5 – 8 x 2 – 2,8 cm, 10 – 13 mm thick, green but densely covered with white hairs, with brown hairs at the tip.
叶片：排列疏松，近莲座形。叶长圆状倒披针形，钝，有短尖，长5 - 8厘米，宽2 - 2,8厘米，厚度10 - 14毫米。叶色绿，密被白色茸毛，尖端的绒毛呈棕色。Inflorescences subspicate to subpaniculate, to 40 cm, pedicels short, mostly single-flowered.
花序：近似于穗状花序或圆锥花序，高可达40厘米，花梗短，多为单花。Flowers: Sepals appressed, to 10 mm, corolla to 18 x 8 mm in diameter near the base, 7 mm in diameter at the mouth, red.
花：萼片贴伏，10毫米，花冠基部附近直径18×8毫米，花冠直径7毫米，花红色。Cytology : n = 38

 E.pulvinata 锦晃星 及其真假、杂交
       一、Echeveria pulvinata 锦晃星原文：http://www.crassulaceae.ch/index.php?TPL=10122&x270_id=1696 翻译：Qiuhan
一切权利属于英文原作者，转载请注明原文链接和译者，欢迎勘误。 Echeveria pulvinata Rose, 1903 锦晃星/绒毛掌，由Rose发表于1903年Synonym : Cotyledon pulvinata  (Rose)  Hooker fil. (1903)
异名 ：Cotyledon pulvinata  (Rose)  Hooker fil. (1903)Distribution : Mexico (Oaxaca) 分布于墨西哥Oaxaca州 Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :
描述（根据2003年IHSP）：
Plants entirely hirsute except inside flowers.
除了花朵内部之外，整株植物被毛。
Stem to 10 cm tall or more, branching. 茎：可高达10cm以上，易分枝。 Leaves subrosulate, obovate, mucronate, 3.5 – 7 x 2 – 2.5 cm, 6 – 7 mm thick, green but densely covered with white or reddish hairs. 叶：近似于莲座状排列，倒卵形，有短尖，3.5-7cm长，2-2.5cm宽，6-7mm厚，绿色，但被有茂密的白色或淡红色毛。 Inflorescences spicate to racemose, or subpaniculate below, to 12 cm tall, pedicels 1 – 1.5 cm, the lowest often with 2 or more flowers.
花序：穗状花序-总状花序，底部可能为亚圆锥花序，可高达12cm，花梗1-1.5cm，底部的花梗上常有2朵或更多的花。 Flowers : Sepals appressed, < ? as long as corolla, to 12 mm, corolla to 16 x 9 mm in diameter near the base, 7 – 12 mm in diameter at the mouth, red. 花：萼片紧贴花瓣，长度小于花冠的1/2，可达12mm；花冠16cm高，基部直径9mm，开口处直径约7-12mm，开口处红色。
Cytology : n = 23
染色体：n=23
Plants in habitat : 栖息地上的植株：

Photos Mieke Geuens
Plants in cultivation : 人工养殖的植株：

An attractive white-haired form, 'Frosty', was found by A. Lau at San Miguel Maninaltepec (Oaxaca) :
一个引人入胜的白毛形态：雪晃星(Echeveria pulvinata 'Frosty')，由A. Lau在Oaxaca州的San Miguel Maninaltepec发现:
Photos Bernie DeChant There is also a crested form : 雪晃星的缀化形态：
Echeveria pulvinata 'Ruby' (选育的锦晃星'Ruby'，同样条件下其红边总是比锦晃星原始种更明显，怀疑园艺市场上流行的应该都是'Ruby'）
Photos Margrit Bischofberger

Photos Christophe Camassel二、真假锦晃星
1.国内市面上卖的锦晃星多为Echeveria 'Leucaria'柳卡利娅(以白兔耳为母本的杂交品种)或者Echeveria 'Pulv-Oliver' 锦之司（锦晃星x花司） 2.国内卖的绒毛掌确实有的是Echeveria pulvinata
3.但国内（尤其是网络上）锦晃星和绒毛掌是混着卖的，也就是说，即便奔着"绒毛掌"买也很有可能买到的是柳卡利娅或者锦之司 4.柳卡利娅和锦晃星的区别有二，一是锦晃星的叶子略厚，而柳卡利娅的叶子更明显地从中对折、叶缘上翻（较像白兔耳），但实际上即便是同一物种不同植株间的叶子差异也很大，这个特征作为鉴别的方法并不可靠。而锦之司和锦晃星的叶子几乎没有差异。
5. 三者间的第二个区别是花，这也是唯一能够确切鉴别这三种植物的方法。 Eceveria pulvinata锦晃星的花萼紧贴花瓣，如图
Echeveria 'Leucaria'柳卡利娅和Echeveria 'Pulv-Oliver' 锦之司的花萼是摊开的，且锦之司的苞叶更大、更多，如图
柳卡利娅，Photos Bev Spiller

锦之司，Photos Bernie DeChant
简单吧~（除了要等开花……）三、Echeveria pulvinata锦晃星的杂交后代

       原文：http://www.crassulaceae.ch/index.php?TPL=10122&x270_id=1910

 E.setosa var.deminuta 小蓝衣
       原文：http://www.crassulaceae.ch/index.php?TPL=10122&x270_id=1911
翻译：Qiuhan一切权利属于英文原作者，转载请注明原文链接和译者。译者是植物学白痴，欢迎勘误。Echeveria setosa var. deminuta J. Meyrán, 1989

异名：Echeveria rondelii  Hort. Sterk (1989)（译者注：Echeveria tundelii应当也是小蓝衣。tundelii=rundelli，我不知道这一步是误传还是确实是异名，但很多地方都说tundelii also known as rundelli或者rundelli also known as tundelii。而rundelli=rondelii，这一步基本可以肯定是误传，因为rundelli并不是rondelii的异名，但rundelli确实是rondelii，因为几乎所有rundelli的资料都指向rondelii。较后Echeveria rondelii 是E. setosa var. deminuta 的异名。详见http://funjing.com/forum.php?mod ... &page=1#pid3811中的讨论。如有错误还请指出。另外，Echeveria 'Jim Rundell'也是小蓝衣，这个名字很不常见了，出现于这个物种刚被发现并引入商业的时候。）
Series Ciliatae
Ciliatae系Distribution : Mexico (Oaxaca : Sierra Mixteca)
分布于墨西哥Oaxaca州的Mixteca山脉Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :

 E.subcorymbosa 蓝宝石和lau 026
       原文来自ICN —— 拟石莲属属下E. subcorymbosa 词条
翻译：种花小医杂家赵一切权利属于英文原作者，转载请注明原文链接和译者。欢迎勘误。
Series Racemosae.
总状花序系Distribution : Mexico (Oaxaca :North of Santiago Juxtlahuaca)
分布：墨西哥（瓦哈卡州：Santiago Juxtlahuaca以北）Description (according to IHSP 2003) :
描述（根据2003年的IHSP）：Stem usually < 4 cm long, 5 – 8 mm in diameter.
茎通常短于4厘米，直径5 - 8毫米。Rosette 4 – 6 cm in diameter.
莲座直径约4到6厘米Leaves obovate-spatulate, cuspidate, 1,5 – 3 x 0,8 – 2,5 cm wide at the widest part, glaucous bluish-grey, often red-flecked beneath, margins reddish.
叶：倒卵状匙形，尖，1.5 - 3厘米长，0.8 - 2.5厘米宽(在较宽的部分)，叶为带有白霜的蓝灰色，叶背面常有红色斑点，叶缘红色。Inflorescences:4,5 – 11 cm, racemose but appearing corymbose because of the long lower pedicels, pedicels sub-erect, 1 – 3 cm, the lowest the longest, each with 1 – 3 minute bracts.
花序：4,5 - 11厘米，总状花序，因为下方的花梗较长，故形似伞房花序。花梗直立，1 - 3厘米长。低位的花梗较长，每个花梗有1 - 3个小苞片。Flowers  3 – 12, sepals slightly ascending, 5 – 11 x 2 – 3 mm, corolla ovoid, pentagonal, 8 – 14 x 6 – 8 mm in diameter, 3 – 4 mm in diameter at the mouth, petals oblong, subobtuse, lower portion reddish-orange, upper part yellow.
花：3 - 12（朵）。萼片稍微上翘，5 - 11毫米长，2 - 3毫米宽。花冠卵圆形，五角形。8 - 14毫米长，花管6 - 8毫米直径，花朵开口3 -4毫米宽。花瓣长圆形，稍钝，近花梗处红橙色，上部黄色。Cytology : n = 29
细胞学检查：染色体数29The population from Tlacotepec has much wider leaves and may be deserving of varietal status.
在Tlacotepec分布的subcorymbosa种群有更宽大的叶片，可能足以获得独立物种地位。
E. subcorymbosa Lau 030 in habitat near Laguna Encantada, Oaxaca, Mexico.

异名：

Echeveria bifurcata Rose (1909)

剑司系

分布于墨西哥Hidalgo州和Queretaro州（持疑）
Description (according to IHSP 2003) :
描述（根据2003年IHSP）：Stem to 6 cm tall or more, ±1 – 1,5 cm in diameter, usually unbranched
茎部：6cm或更高，±1-1.5cm直径，茎部通常不分枝。Rosette 6 – 10 ( - 20 cm) in diameter.
莲座：6-10（-20）cm直径。Leaves lanceolate to rhomboid-oblanceolate, acuminate, mucronate, 4 -10 x 1 – 2,5 cm, upper face, concave to flat, green to purplish.
叶：披针形到菱形-倒披针形，渐尖，有短尖，4-10cm长，1-2.5cm宽，上表面下凹或平坦，绿色到淡紫色。Inflorescences single, to 3-branched cincinni, with 6 – 20 flowers, pedicels 1 – 4 (- 8) mm.

染色体：n=12
Although Walther (1972) recognized 3 other species distinct from E. bifida, all have the same chromosome number and differ in such minor details as stem length, the concavity of the upper leaf face, number of inflorescences branches and length of the pedicels. They all seem better reduced under E. bifida.
尽管Walther曾认为有三种与贝飞达不同的物种（译者注：即Echeveria bifurcata、Echeveria erubescens、Echeveria tenuifolia ，但它们的染色体数目全都相同，且四者之间的差异非常细微，比如茎部的长度、上表面的下凹程度、花序上的分枝数目和花梗的长度。因此，其他三种较好也都归于贝飞达名下。

Pilbeam的《Echeveria》一书中第60页上第39幅插图（by B. Kemble）很具有误导性：E. bifurcata（贝飞达的异名）的花下半部分应该是淡黄色的，不是白色，上部应该是淡粉色至淡红色的，不是深红色。

    "calycosa"应来源于拉丁语,意为"有翘起苞片的"。草拟中文名时看到出状态的成株图，色调金绿，叶薄纤弱，颇有花姿。如唐朝仕女额上所贴花黄。花黄也称花子，是古代妇女脸部的一种女性额饰，又称额黄、鹅黄、鸭黄、约黄等。它是用彩色光纸、绸罗、云母片、蝉翼、蜻蜒翅乃至鱼骨等为原料，染成金黄、霁红或翠绿等色，剪作花、鸟、鱼等形，粘贴于额头、酒靥、嘴角、鬓边等处。故引唐代温庭筠词《菩萨蛮 小山重叠金明灭》中【金明灭】一词——"额上若隐若现的花黄"，拟为中文名。
CALYCOSA Moran, 1967.

请注意：Unfortunately these now obsolete names are still cherished in private as well as in public collections, producing much confusion because usually applied to the wrong plants. An example : What is distributed as E. potosina is a freely offsetting plant – but the description of E. potosina clearly states that this is a plant with few or no offsets. This means that the photo in Pilbeam, Echeveria, p. 106, Fig. 117, showing a heavily clustering plant, is wrong.
不幸的是，这些早已成为过去式的名字如今仍在爱好者之间广为流传，制造了许多货不对板的误解。比如说，作为星影售卖的东西是一个特别爱分头群生的家伙，但根据星影的描述它极少有分头的习性。这也意味着在Pilbeam的《Echeveria》一书中第106页图177上那个群生的植物并非星影。And plants labeled as E. kesselringiana usually are simply E. albicans – now also a synonym for E. elegans. Of all now synonymous species of E. elegans, the latter is the one best to be distinguished from what is commonly known as E. elegans and is mostly correctly named.
而被冠以"月影之宵"名字的植物通常只是厚叶月影而已，现在也只是月影大家庭的一个普通成员。而厚叶月影倒确实是所有那些月影的异名植物里较容易和普通月影区分开的，也是比较不容易货不对板的一个。（这一段在我兔地盘上同样成立）

海冰格丽，由Walther发表于1972年Series Urbiniae
瓮花系
Distribution: Mexico (Hidalgo: S of Actopán, El Arenal, Cerro de las Canteras)
分布于：墨西哥Hidalgo州的Actopán北部，El Arenal, Cerro de las Canteras
Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :
描述（根据2003年IHSP）：Stem nearly lacking, branching.
几乎无茎，茎部易分头Rosette 5 – 6 cm in diameter, caespitose.
莲座5-6cm直径，易群生。Leaves densely crowded, obovate, ± 2,5 x 1,3 cm, obtuse, minutely aristate-apiculate, glaucous green.
叶：排列密实，倒卵形，约2.5-1.3cm直径，顶部呈钝角，有细尖，绿色略带霜。Inflorescences a single cincinnus to 12 cm, pedicels 6 mm.  
花序：单蝎尾状聚伞花序，可达12cm，花梗6mm。Flowers: Sepals ascending to spreading, to 6 mm, corolla urceolate-campanulate, ± 12 mm long, petals subulate-apiculate, tips strongly recurved, reddish-orange to yellowish.
花：萼片上翘或摊开，可达6mm；花冠瓮形-钟形，约12mm长；花瓣钻形-镞形，顶端明显反折，淡粉色到淡黄色。Cytology : n = 62
染色体：n=62
Distributed by ISI n° 168 (1959)
ISI编号168（1959年）
Photo Jacquie Koutsoudis
Photo Emmanuelle Aubé

Photo Margrit BischofbergerP.S.
强烈谴责淘宝把海冰格丽及其种子当月影卖的商家，海冰比月影汉子多了好吗（咦？）海冰不是月影系的。目前海冰有一个变种Echeveria halbingeri var. sanchez-mejoradae ，"和月影有点像"。它原称作Echeveria sanchez-mejoradae，一开始就特别混乱，可能有两种完全不同的植物都被冠以了这个名字。1998年，Kimnach将它并入了海冰格丽，但这是一次饱受诟病的合并，因为二者之间花的差异远非variety能解释的，因此这次合并很可能并不科学。这件事说来话长，下次再聊。

以海冰格丽为亲本的杂交品种：Echeveria 'Alber'

Echeveria heterosepala 望帝 - 千种多肉植物图鉴 - 梦桑阁


  
 Echeveria heterosepala 望帝
       原文：ICN
图源：ICN & Flickr
（一切权利归原作者 \ 转载请注明出处）（按：E. heterosepala为拟石莲属Chloranthae系的独生子，其花色在E属中无可比拟。此莲开放时带有象征春天和农耕的鲜绿花色，而后转红，这恰似战国时的蜀王望帝，对大地和百姓胸怀热爱，满眼是万物逢春的殷切希冀，较后化作杜鹃啼血声声；李商隐句"望帝春心托杜鹃"即是对其期盼之心的绝妙写照。E. heterosepala 故拟名"望帝"，以寄托此莲透出的浓浓绿意与热忱。）HETEROSEPALA Rose, 1903.
由Rose在1903年命名Synonyms \ 异名  :
Pachyphytum heterosepalum (Rose) Walther (1935)
Pachyphytum chloranthum Walther (1931)
Echeveria viridiflora Rose ms ex von Poellnitz (1936)
（译著：其系Chloranthae名词根chlo-为"绿色"之意，rant-为"咆哮"之意，ae为所有格词尾 —— 由此可见命名者惊叹其叶、花、萼近乎全绿的特点。种名词根hetero- 为"异 \ 非同" 之意，sepala为萼片之意，连在一起heterosepala即为"与众不同的花萼" 。它曾在1931\1935年被两次划入厚叶草属。）Series Chloranthae \ Chloranthae 系  Distribution: Mexico (Puebla: Esperanza, Cerro de Paxtle ; Oaxaca: Tlacotepec)
分布：墨西哥（普埃布拉州的Esperanza 和 Cerro de Paxtle地区 ；瓦哈卡州的Tlacotepec地区 ） Description \ 描述 (according to IHSP, 2003) ：
Stem < 4 cm long, sparsely branching. Rosette 4 – 6 cm in diameter ( ? ? does not correspond to the length of the leaves [MB]). Leaves rhomboid-lanceolate, aristate-mucronate, 4 – 7 x 1,5 – 2 cm, grey-green. Inflorescence a cincinnus to 50 cm long or more, bracts easily detached, pedicels 3 – 7 mm. Flowers : Sepals 5 – 7 mm, ascending to spreading ; corolla broadly urceolate, ± 10 mm long, green in bud, later red ; petals with basal hollow within, often bearing an appendage on either side as in Pachyphytum. 
茎< 4厘米长，少有分枝。莲座直径 4 - 6厘米（此处[MB]原注：有误，叶即长于此直径 ）叶菱形披针形，具芒尖， 长4 - 7厘米× 宽1.5 - 2厘米，灰绿色。花序倒蝎尾，长50厘米或以上，苞片容易脱落，花梗长3 - 7毫米。花：萼片长5 - 7毫米，上举或外展；花冠宽壶状， 长±10毫米，花先绿，后而略转红；花内具较大空间，并像厚叶草属一样，在花的一侧生有附属物。Cytology : n = 13
染色体： N = 13One of the few Echeverias growing in arid conditions on flat ground. It is difficult to maintain in cultivation.
此种生长在近乎干旱的平地上，这在石莲中不太常见。在园艺条件下营造类似生长环境不太容易。Distributed by ISI n°196 (1961)
曾发表在ISI第196期 （ 1961）

 Echeveria lauii 雪莲
       原文：http://www.crassulaceae.ch/index.php?TPL=10122&x270_id=1429
翻译：Qiuhan转载请注明原文链接和译者
LAUI Moran & J. Meyrán, 1976
雪莲，由Moran和J. Meyrán发表于1976年
Series Pruinosae
Pruinosae系
Distribution: Mexico (Oaxaca: in one of the lateral ravines of the Rio Salado-Quiotepec), 500 m alt, growing in a hot and dry area.
分布于墨西哥瓦哈卡州的一条山谷里，海拔500米，气候干燥炎热。
Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :
描述（根据2003年IHSP）：
Stem usually 5 – 10 x ± 1,5 cm in diameter, unbranched, covered below with persistent dry leaves.
茎部：通常5-10cm高、直径1.5cm左右，不分枝，底部堆积干枯的叶片。
Rosette 12 – 15 cm in diameter.
莲座：12-15厘米直径。
Leaves obovate, broadly obtuse, minutely mucronate, 5 – 8,5 x 3 – 4,5 cm, 6 – 8 mm thick, upper face nearly flat to slightly concave, strongly white-glaucous or sometimes pinkish glaucous.
叶子：倒卵形，线条圆润，有一个小小的叶尖，5-8.5厘米长，3-4.5厘米宽，6-8mm厚，上表面几乎是平的或者微微下凹，覆有一层厚厚的白霜，白霜有时候发淡粉色。
Inflorescence 6 – 10 cm long, with 5 – 7 conspicuous heavily glaucous bracts, cincinnus with 9 – 17 flowers, pedicels 2 – 4 mm.
花序：6-10cm高，上有5-7片覆有白霜的苞叶，苞叶很明显，蝎尾状聚伞花序上有9-17朵花，花梗约2-4mm。
Flowers : Sepals ascending, very unequal, 3 – 18 mm, corolla pentagonal-pyramidal, 13 – 16 mm long, red but heavily pruinose.
花：花萼向上生长，非常不规则，3-18mm；花冠是五角的锥形，13-16mm长，红色，但覆着一层厚厚的白霜。
Cytology : n = 15
染色体：n=15
Distributed by ISI n° 1199 (1980).

       原文：http://www.crassulaceae.ch/index.php?TPL=10122&x270_id=1197

Synonym : Echeveria lutea var. fuscata  E. Walther (1972)
异名：Echeveria lutea var. fuscata  E. Walther (1972)Series Angulatae
Angulatae系Distribution: Mexico (San Luis Potosí)
分布于墨西哥的San Luis Potosí。Description (according to IHSP, 2003):
描述（根据2003年IHSP）：
Roots thickened.
根系浓密。Stem < 5 cm long, 1 – 2 cm in diameter, sparsely branching.
茎：长度小于5cm，直径1-2cm，茎部很少分枝。Rosette 8 – 13 cm in diameter.
莲座：直径8-13cm。Leaves densely rosulate, linear-elliptic to oblanceolate, long-acuminate, tip acute, upcurving, deeply channelled above, 4 – 5 x 0,8 – 1,8 cm, 3 – 7 mm thick, green to brownish-green.

花：萼片大张，有些下弯；花冠为明显的五角形，12-17mm长，底部8-12mm直径，顶部2-5mm直径，黄色。

 Echeveria megacalyx 玉壶光
       种名的意思是"巨大的苞片"，因此种株型圆润，叶薄透光，色调金黄。故取辛弃疾《青玉案 元夕》中"凤箫声动，玉壶光转，一夜鱼龙舞"中【玉壶光】一词拟为中文名——喻其如月光流转。原文：http://www.crassulaceae.ch/index.php?TPL=10122&x270_id=1445
翻译：种花小医杂家赵一切权利属于英文原作者，转载请注明原文链接和译者。欢迎勘误。MEGACALYX Walther, 1959
megacalyx  由walther发表于1959年Series Racemosae
总状花序系Distribution: Mexico (Oaxaca)
栖息地：墨西哥（瓦哈卡）Description (according to IHSP, 2003):描述（根据IHSP，2003年）;Stem sparsely branching, < 5 cm long, 1,5 – 2 cm in diameter.茎干少见分支，<5厘米长，1.5 - 2厘米的直径。Rosette 6 – 9 cm in diameter. *
莲座6 - 10厘米直径。 *Leaves oblong-spatulate, mucronate,margins translucent and dentate-lacerate, 3 – 10 x 2 – 3 cm, green to slightly bluish-glaucous.
叶长圆状匙形，有尖，边缘半透明的，有齿状缺刻，3 - 10×2 - 3厘米，叶片绿色略微偏蓝，覆盖白霜。Inflorescences racemes to 45 cm, ± 8 mm near base, pedicels of lower flowers 3 – 8 mm, of upper flowers very short.
花序：总状花序约45厘米长，近基部约8毫米粗，低位着生的花柄3–8毫米长，高位花的花柄很短。Flowers: Sepals somewhat spreading, large and leaves-like, obovate-elliptic, acute, 8 – 10 x ± 6 mm; corolla urceolate, ± 8 x 5 – 8 mm in diameter near tip, dull green-yellow.
花：萼片稍平展，宽如叶片，倒卵状椭圆形，有尖，大小8–±10 x 6毫米；花冠瓶形，尖端直径±8 x 5–8毫米，花暗黄绿色。Cytolog: n = 20.

Fig. 215, p. 169, in Pilbeam, Echeveria, is not correct, petals are not recurving and the  flower colour does not correspond to the description cited on pages 169, 170.

Echeveria nodulosa 红司及其杂交 - 千种多肉植物图鉴 - 梦桑阁


  
 Echeveria nodulosa 红司及其杂交
       原文：http://www.crassulaceae.ch/index ... p;x270_listsearch=1
翻译：种花小医杂家赵一切权利属于英文原作者，转载请注明原文链接和译者。欢迎勘误。
NODULOSA (Baker) Otto, 1873
Synonyms:
Cotyledon nodulosa  Baker (1869)
Echeveria discolor  De Smet (1874)
Echeveria misteca  De Smet ex Morren (1874)
Echeveria sturmiana  von Poellnitz (1938)
Echeveria nodulosa var. minor  E. Walther (1972)异名：
Cotyledon nodulosa  Baker (1869)
Echeveria discolor  De Smet (1874)
Echeveria misteca  De Smet ex Morren (1874)
Echeveria sturmiana  von Poellnitz (1938)
Echeveria nodulosa var. minor  E. Walther (1972)Series Nudae
Nudae系Distribution: Mexico (widely distributed and rather common in North Oaxaca and South Puebla).
分布：墨西哥（分布广泛,而在北瓦哈卡州和南普埃布拉极为常见）Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :
描述(根据IHSP,2003):Stems to 20 cm long, much-branched, irregularly angular.
茎长20厘米，多分枝，茎干上有不规则的角状突出。Leaves, bracts, sepals and outside of petals minutely papillose.
叶，苞片，萼片和花瓣均为磨砂质感。Leaves subrosulate to scattered, obovate-cuneate, acute, to 5 x 1,5 cm, ± heavily marked with purplish-red on both faces and along margins, rarely entirely green.
叶序为较为松散的玫瑰型（此句存疑），叶倒卵形楔形，尖，5×1.5厘米大小，叶正反面和叶缘可有浓烈的紫红色条纹，很少完全绿色。Inflorescences racemose, to 30 cm, pedicels to 5 mm.
总状花序，30厘米长，花梗到5毫米。Flowers: Sepals widely spreading, rarely reflexed, upcurving at tips, corolla sharply pentagonal, ± 16 mm long, petals rose, yellowish along margins and at tips.
花：萼片平展，很少反折，顶端上翘。花冠五边形，大约长16毫米，花瓣玫红色，沿着边缘和尖端呈黄色。Cytology : n = 16
细胞学检查：染色体数=16条Distributed by ISI n° 420 (1963) and ISI n° 1137 (1979) as E. nodulosa 'Painted Beauty', a clone with especially beautiful markings.
ISI n° 420 (1963) 和ISI n° 1137 (1979) 描述了一种拥有特别优美条纹的红司栽培种（？）—— E. nodulosa 'Painted Beauty'（拟翻译为"朱颜红司"）Note :
This species is much more variable than the description implies. There are forms with sessile rosettes, green plants are not really rare, but on the other hand stem growing plants are often not much-branched.
(MB)
注：
相较于品种标准描述而言，红司实际形态则很多变。有近乎无茎干的莲座型植株，纯绿色植株也并不罕见。但另一方面，那些符合长茎干描述的植株，通常分枝也不多。See also : Echeveria nodulosa 'Painted Beauty'

segments.t:
Echeveria pallida 霜之鹤及其杂交种 - 千种多肉植物图鉴 - 梦桑阁


  
 Echeveria pallida 霜之鹤及其杂交种
       翻译：种花小医杂家赵
一切权利属于英文原作者，转载请注明原文链接和译者。欢迎勘误。PALLIDA Walther, 1938
霜之鹤 由Walther发表于1938年Series Gibbiflorae
粉彩莲系Distribution: Mexico
栖息地：墨西哥Description (according to IHSP, 2003):
形态描述（根据IHSP  2003版）：Stem branching, to 10 cm long or more, ± 15 mm in diameter.
茎多分枝，高度可超过10厘米，直径15毫米左右。Rosette 15 – 20 cm in diameter.
莲座直径15到20厘米。Leaves obovate-spatulate, > 15 x 9 cm, obtuse, mucronate, light green.
叶片倒卵状匙形，＞15×9厘米，钝，有短尖，淡绿色。Inflorescences to 50 cm, cymose-paniculate, with 8 or more cincinni, these sometimes 2-branched, pedicels < 6 mm.
花序长50厘米，聚伞状圆锥花序，可有8支或更多的蝎尾状分支，有时蝎尾状花序会2次再分枝，花梗小于6毫米。Flowers: Sepals very unequal, to 14 mm, corolla 16 x 12 mm in diameter near the base, scarlett to pink.
花：萼片大小差异悬殊，约14毫米，花冠基部直径16 x 12毫米，花色从深红色渐过渡粉红色。Cytology : n = 54
细胞学检查：染色体 = 54This plant is evidently not a hybrid, but a native locality has not yet been recorded.
这个物种显然不是一个杂交品种，但它没有自然栖息地的记录。

Photos Margrit Bischofberger———————————————— 分割线 ————————————————
霜之鹤作为亲本得到的杂交品种，在国内流传的不多，大家比较熟悉的如白凤，花之鹤等。它的子代一般拥有宽大的、稍有褶边的柠檬绿色叶片，植株体量也较大，可作为岩石园花境的主体植物，嫩绿色的叶片充满蓬勃活力。1  agavoides x pallida

2 Lawrence  花之鹤
起源不明
亲本：花月夜*霜之鹤
在韩国这种杂交种被称为 Echeveria 'Pallida Prince'. 此名是不符合命名规范的，因为杂交品种的名字里不能带有原始种的名字。

3 Lemon Twist  柠檬卷
Created by J. Napton

由 E. Lillie命名

5 Margrit ''

6Hakuhou ''白凤

 Echeveria paniculata龙田凤及其变种
       一切权力属于原英文作者，译者不懂植物学，欢迎指正
转载请注明原作者&译者。原文：ICN
译者：柳下杜拉罕

原种：龙田凤
PANICULATA var. PANICULATA Gray, 1852.Synonyms:
异名：
Cotyledon greyi Baker (1869) / Echeveria greyi (Baker) Morren (1874)Series Thyrsiflorae
聚伞圆锥花序系Distribution: Mexico (Chihuahua, Durango, Zacatecas)
地理分布：墨西哥（奇瓦瓦州，Durango州, Zacatecas州）Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :
描述：（根据2003年IHSP）Roots fusiform, fleshy.
根纺锤形，肉质。Stem nearly lacking, rarely branching.
几乎没有茎，少分枝。Rosette ± 10 – 12 cm in diameter.
莲座直径± 10 -12厘米Leaves spreading horizontally, oblanceolate, acuminate, ± 10 x 3 cm, rather thin, green.
叶片水平张开，倒披针形，渐尖，±10×3厘米，微薄，绿色。Inflorescences cymose-paniculate, branches 6 – 8, each with 1 – 6 flowers, pedicels short.
花序为聚伞状圆锥花序，分枝6–8，每支花茎生有1–6花，花梗短。Flowers: Sepals more ascending than in var. maculata, to 10 mm, corolla ± 12 x 9 mm in diameter near the base, reddish-yellow near the base, yellow above.
花：萼片比其变种var. maculata更长，约10毫米，花冠近基部，直径±12 x 9毫米，基部红黄色，上面黄色。Cytology : n = 28
染色体：n=28


Photos Mieke Geuens

E. paniculata, Durango, Mazatlan
Photos Emmanuelle Aubé
Photo Noelene Tomlinson

变种：
PANICULATA var. MACULATA (Rose) Kimnach 1998.Synonyms:
异名：
Echeveria maculata Rose (1903)
Echeveria longipes E. Walther (1935)Series Thyrsiflorae
聚伞圆锥花序系Distribution: Mexico (Hidalgo, Querétero, Michoacán, San Luis Potosí, Zacatecas, Jalisco).

不同于原种 龙田凤：Leaves narrowly rhomboid-oblanceolate, 7 – 10 x 1,5 – 2,5 cm, rather thick and more succulent.
叶片狭菱形倒披针形，7-10×1.5-2.5厘米，相当厚，肉质。Inflorescences thyrses, either subpaniculate below and spicate-racemose above or with numerous, mostly 2-flowered branchlets, pedicels 1 – 2 (-16) mm.
花序为聚伞圆锥花序，既不及圆锥花序同时又超过穗状的总状花序，或者带有大量的大多生有2花的小枝，花梗1–2（16）毫米。Flowers : Sepals widely expanding, to 8 mm, corolla ± 16 x 9 mm in diameter near the base, yellow.
花：萼片普遍平展，8毫米，花冠直径±16 x 9毫米，近基部，黄色。Cytology : n = 28
染色体：n=28

 Echeveria pinetorum 松间莲
       原文：http://www.crassulaceae.ch/index.php?TPL=10122&x270_id=1833
翻译：Qiuhan一切权利属于原作者，转载请注明原文链接和译者，欢迎勘误。
Echeveria pinetorum Rose, 1905
松间莲，由Rose发表于1905年Synonyms:
异名：
Echeveria sessiliflora var. pinetorum  (Rose) von Poellnitz (1936)
Echeveria huehueteca  Standley & Steyermark (1944).Series Mucronatae
尖叶系
Distribution : Mexico (Chiapas, Oaxaca), Guatemala
分布于：墨西哥的Chipas州，Oaxaca州，Guatemala州Description (according to E. Walther, Echeveria, 1972) :
描述（根据E. Walther1972年的Echeveria一书）：Roots fleshy, fusiform.
纺锤状的肉质根。Stem nearly lacking, branching.
几乎无茎，可分枝。Rosettes dense, up to 20 leaves.
莲座紧实，可达20片叶。Leaves often deciduous during the dry season, narrowly oblanceolate, acute to acuminate, 2 – 4 x 1 – 1,5 cm, rather thick, above flat or shallowly concave, rounded beneath, often denticulate when young, yellowish green.
叶为窄倒披针形，叶子有尖或渐尖，2-4cm长，1-1.5cm宽，较厚，上表面平坦或微凹，下表面圆润；新叶常有细齿；干旱季节叶子常脱落。Inflorescences spicate, to 30 cm tall, bracts appressed, to 3 cm, pedicels usually quite short, only rarely as much as 8 mm long.
穗状花序，可达30cm高；苞叶平贴，可达3cm；花梗通常较短，很少有8mm以上。Flowers : Sepals unequal, to 3 mm, corolla 8 – 10 x 6 mm in diameter near the base, 4 mm in diameter at the mouth, petals scarcely spreacing at tips, scarlet at the base, yellowish above.
花：萼片大小不均，可达3mm；花冠8-10mm高，基部6mm直径，口部4mm直径；花瓣几乎不绽开，基部鲜红色，顶部黄色。Cytology : n = 14
染色体：n=14

请注意：Whether Fig. 282, p. 208, in J. Pilbeam, Echeveria, of a 13 cm (!) wide seedling really shows E. pinetorum is rather doubtful.

 Echeveria prolifica 子持白莲
       原文地址：http://www.crassulaceae.ch/index.php?TPL=10122&x270_id=1869由Moran 和 J. Meyrán于1978命名。
穿心莲样分支系列（Series Paniculatae）Distribution: Mexico (Puebla)
Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :
Stem < 3cm long, 4 – 7 mm in diameter, proliferous by stolons.
Rosette 4 – 8 cm in diameter.子持白莲：
原生地位于Mexico 的Puebla。形态描述(根据IHSP,2003):子持白莲的茎干不超过3厘米长,直径约4 - 7毫米,通过地面匍匐茎形成群生。其单个莲座可生长至4 - 8厘米直径。Leaves obovate-cuncate, obtuse, cuspidate, 2 – 4 x 1 - 1,6 cm, 4 – 8 mm thick, convex on both faces, light glaucous-green.Inflorescences sprawling-decumbent, cymose, 15 – 25 cm long, bracts easily detached and rooting to form new plants, the cyme dense, 2 – 3 cm wide, with 2 – 5 cincinni, each with up to 4 flowers, pedicels ± 1 mm.Flowers : Calyx cup-shaped, sepals upcurved, corolla campanulate, 5 – 6 mm long, yellow.子持白莲的叶片呈倒卵形，钝园，叶尖处骤尖。长度2到4厘米，宽度1 到 1.6厘米，厚4到8毫米，叶片两面凸出，呈亮蓝绿色，覆盖着白霜。
花序呈匍匐生长状态，聚伞状，15到25厘米长。花梗上的叶状苞片很容易脱落，可生根形成新的植株。花序在植株上密集分布，每2–3厘米宽可再生长出新的蝎尾状聚伞花序，每个蝎尾状聚伞花序上较多可开出4朵花。花梗约1毫米左右长。
花萼杯状，萼片上弯，花朵瓮状，5–6毫米长，黄色。
Cytology : n = 33The stout campanulate flowers are unique in the genus. As with its ally, E. amoena, it will easily spread because of its deciduous bracts.Distributed by ISI n° 1388 (1983)细胞学：染色体=33。子持白莲拥有矮胖的瓮形花朵，这在拟石莲花属中较为独特，这与它的近亲E. amoena（花乃锦/雨村）很相像。子持白莲很容易蔓延繁殖形成群生，因为它花茎上脱落的叶状苞片极易出芽形成幼株。ISI编号为1388，1983年录入。

segments.t:
Echeveria pulidonis 花月夜 及其杂交 - 千种多肉植物图鉴 - 梦桑阁


  
 Echeveria pulidonis 花月夜 及其杂交
       原文：http://www.crassulaceae.ch/index ... p;x270_listsearch=1
翻译：Qiuhan
一切权利属于英文原作者，转载请注明原文链接和译者。译者不懂植物学，欢迎勘误。Echeveria pulidonis Walther, 1972.
花月夜，由Walther发表于1972年Series Urbiniae
瓮花系
Distribution: Mexico (Hidalgo: Beristain).
分布于墨西哥Hidalgo州的Beristain
Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :
描述（根据2003年IHSP）：Plants nearly stemless, glabrous.
几乎无茎，光洁无毛。Stem branching.
茎部可分枝。Rosette 7 – 9 cm in diameter.
莲座：7-9cm直径。Leaves obovate-oblong, minutely mucronate, 3,5 – 5 x 1,2 – 1,5 cm, green, conspicuously red-margined.
叶：倒卵状椭圆形，有细短尖，3.5-5cm长，1.2-1.5cm宽，绿色，有明显的红边。Inflorescence a cincinnus, apical portion strongly nodding in bud, to 18 cm long, pedicels 6 mm.
花序：单根的蝎尾状聚伞花序，顶部聚集许多花蕾，可长达18cm；花梗6mm。Flowers: Corolla bluntly pentagonal, to 10 mm long, yellow, petals strongly recurving apically.
花：花冠为圆润的五边形，长可达10mm，黄色，花瓣顶部明显反折。Cytology : n = 32, 62, 64.
染色体：n=32,62,64

Photos Emmanuelle Aubé 
Echeveria pulidonis是日韩以整个园艺界非常钟爱的杂交亲本之一，其艳丽的红边、标致的株型和好生养的特性都是非常宝贵的基因，尤其适合亚洲地区作为阳台或花园里的盆栽植物。比较有特点的杂交品种包括（资料all from ICN)：

Echeveria purpusorum 大和锦 - 千种多肉植物图鉴 - 梦桑阁


  
 Echeveria purpusorum 大和锦
       原文：http://www.crassulaceae.ch/index.php?TPL=10122&x270_id=431
翻译：Qiuhan转载请注明原文链接和译者。Echeveria purpusorum 
大和锦
Berger，1930
由Berger发表于1930年
Series Urbiniae
Urbiniae系
Distribution : Mexico (Puebla, near San Luis Atolotitlán)
分布：墨西哥San Luis Atolotitlán附近的Puebla
Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :
描述（根据2003年IHSP）：
Stem usually 5 – 8 cm high, ± 2 cm in diameter, rarely branching.
茎：5-8cm高，2cm左右直径，茎部很少分枝。
Rosettes 6 – 7 cm in diameter and high.
莲座：直径和高均为6-7cm.
Leaves ovate-acuminate, acute, ± 3 – 3.5 x 2 – 2.5 cm, to 1 cm thick, sharp-edged, obscurely keeled on the back, light olive-green, heavily mottled and spotted with irregular reddish-brown markings, margin translucent, unspotted.
叶：卵形-渐尖形，尖端锐利；±3至3.5cm长，2-2.5cm宽，1cm厚；边缘锐利，背部隐约有一条脊线；淡橄榄绿色，颜色斑驳，有红棕色的不规则斑点；边缘半透明，无斑点。
Inflorescence a cincinnus, unbranched, to 20 cm tall, pedicels to 12 mm.

Echeveria runyonii 鲁氏 (和特玉莲) - 千种多肉植物图鉴 - 梦桑阁


  
 Echeveria runyonii 鲁氏 (和特玉莲)
       原文：http://www.crassulaceae.ch/index.php?TPL=10122&x270_id=1898
翻译：Qiuhan一切权利属于英文原作者，转载请注明原文链接和译者。译者是植物学白痴，欢迎勘误。Echeveria runyonii Rose ex Walther, 1935
鲁氏石莲花（ex之前还是之后的那个人是更新的我忘记了）Synonym : Echeveria runyonii var.macabeana
异名：Echeveria runyonii var.macabeanaSeries Pruinosae
Pruinosae系Distribution: Mexico (Tamaulipas)
分布于：墨西哥的TamaulipasDescription (according to IHSP, 2003) :
描述（根据2003年IHSP）：Stem usually single, to 10 cm long or more, ± 1 cm in diameter.
茎部：通常单枝，可达10cm甚至更高，直径1cm左右。Rosette 8 – 10 cm in diameter.
莲座：直径8-10cm。Leaves spatulate-cuneate to oblong-spatulate, truncate to acuminate, mucronate, 6 – 8 x 2,5 – 4 cm, glaucous pinkish-white.
叶：铲形-楔形到椭圆形-铲形，顶端截面-渐尖，有短尖，6-8cm长，2.5-4cm宽，被霜为淡粉色-白色。Inflorescences 2 or more, 15 - 20 cm tall, with 2 – 3 cincinni, bracts conspicuous, pedicels ± 4 mm.
花序：2根或更多，15-20cm高，上有2-3根蝎尾状聚伞花序，苞叶明显，花梗4mm左右。Flowers : Sepals ascending-spreading to 11 mm, corolla pentagonal, 19 – 20 x 10 mm in diameter, scarlet.
花：萼片竖直或摊开，可达11mm；花冠为五边形，19-20mm高，10mm直径，猩红色。Cytology : n = 14
染色体：n=14
Note :
请注意：1. According to E. Walther Echeveria runyonii has been found in a garden at Matamoras, Tamaulipas, Mexico, as a cultivated plant, and no habitat was known. The indication in IHSP of Nuevo León as distribution region is wrong.
1. 根据E. Walther所言，鲁氏石莲花被发现于墨西哥Tamaulipas的一座花园里，是一种用于园艺的植物，自然栖息地不明。这意味着IHSP中说其分布于Nuevo León是错的。As a footnote M. Kimnach adds that "it has recently been found wild in Nuevo León" – this is also not correct, it has recently been collected wild in Tamaulipas.
M. Kimnach对此有一段脚注，是说"较近在Nuevo León发现了野生植株"——这也不对，野生植株较近是在Tamaulipas收集到的。This means that most likely there is no E. runyonii in Nuevo León.
Nuevo León很可能根本就没有鲁氏石莲花。Also the former var. macabeana is only known from cultivation.
而且之前的变种macabeana也只在园艺中现身。
（译者注：意为没有相对独立的野生栖息地所以不能称之为var.）
2. Several cultivars of this species has been named, e.g. 'Texas Rose', 'Dr. Butterfield', 'Lucita', 'Tom Allen' (Australia).  These plants are not conspicuously different from E. runyonii and the names may well be just nursery names for plants either not recognized as the species or renamed for the sake of listing a new name in a catalogue. To our knowledge none of these cultivars has been described or defined, so it is not even clear whether the above mentioned names are applied properly.  Moreover from leaf you can get any of those forms, even 2 leaf shapes growing off one leaf, and at any time they can turn into 'Topsy Turvy'.
2. 这个物种有一些园艺品种流传，比如'Texas Rose', 'Dr. Butterfield', 'Lucita', 'Tom Allen' （澳大利亚）等。这些品种和鲁氏都没有显著的不同，可能只是一些苗圃起的名字罢了，这些植株要么是没有被认出是鲁氏，要么是因为想在商品目录里多几个名字而瞎改名的。就我们所知，这些品种无一曾被详细地描述或定义过，所以这些名字是否合适都还两说。此外，这些形态通过叶插都可以得到，而且样子不同的两片叶子完全可能插出同样的植株，同时它们随时都可能变成特玉莲。Therefore these names are not taken into account here.
因此这些名字不在本文的考虑范围之内。（译者注：无论是ssp. var. f.还是cultivar，必须1.特征显著 2.特征稳定，两个条件缺一不可，市面上贩卖的许多所谓"品种"实际上都是nursery name，即苗圃和大棚出于商业目的而起的艺名（咦？），说没有被描述/定义因此不正规是一方面，二是可能养着养着发现换个环境就不是那么回事儿了，且连无性繁殖都未必能够得到相似的后代，即所谓的特征不稳定。倒不是说这样就没有价值，毕竟喜欢大于一切/千金难买我高兴，但掏钱的时候要考虑清楚）
Photo Emmanuelle Aubé
Plant James Barry Slabbert, South Africa

Photos Jacquie Koutsoudis
Echeveria runyonii San Carlos, Tamaulipas
在Tamaulipas的San Carlos的鲁氏：
Photos Rudolf Zacher

Photo Margrit Bischofberger
An interesting mutation, with leaves appearing to be positioned upside-down, is E. runyonii 'Topsy Turvy' which originated in cultivation in California. Very often the flowers are heavily distorted and more rarely even the flower stalk is fasciated :
一种有趣的变异，叶子反折向下，这就是特玉莲，是在加利福尼亚的人工养殖中出现的。通常它连花都是畸形的，偶尔连花柄都是扁的：
Photos Bouke Clement

Echeveria strictiflora A. Gray, 1852
剑司，由A. Gray发表于1852年Synonym : Cotyledon strictiflora
异名：Cotyledon strictifloraSeries Angulatae
剑司系
Distribution : USA (Texas), Mexico (Coahuila, Chihuahua?, Nuevo León?)

Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :
描述（根据2003年IHSP):Stem < 3 cm tall, 0,5 – 1,5 cm in diameter, rarely branching.
茎部：小于3cm高，0.5-1.5cm直径，很少分枝。Leaves rosulate, ascending-spreading, oblanceolate-rhombic, acute, 3 – 9 x 1,5 – 3 cm, grey-green or buff- green, with or without a red margin.
叶：莲座状排列，向上伸展或摊开；倒披针形-菱形，顶端尖锐，3-9cm长，1.5-3cm宽，灰绿色或浅黄色-绿色，有些有红边，有些没有。Inflorescences secund-racemose, unbranched or rarely 2-branched, 20 – 25 cm tall, pedicels ± 1 mm .
花序：secund-racemose（不知对应的中文是什么），不分枝，偶尔会分出2枝，20-25cm高；花梗1mm左右。Flowers : Sepals ascending, 9 – 13 mm, corolla conoid to urceolate-campanulate, strongly pentagonal, rose near the base, yellowish-red above, 13 x 15 x 8 mm in diameter ner the base, 5 mm in diameter at the mouth.
花：萼片撑开，9-13mm；花冠圆锥形-瓮形-钟形，非常明显的五边形，基部玫红色，顶部淡黄色-红色，基部13x15x8mm，顶部5mm直径。Of interest as the only echeveria native to the USA. It is also one of the more difficult species to cultivate.
令人感兴趣的是，这是唯一一种原产于美国的拟石莲花，也是较难人工培植的拟石莲花之一。Some populations in Texas and Mexico have red-margined leaves but seem to be uncorrelated geographically.
德州和墨西哥的一些种群有红边，但红边这一特征似乎与地理分布无关。A plant collected by A. Lau in the Sierra Gomas, west of Bustamante, Nuevo León, has unusually broad leaves (to 4 cm wide) and after further study may be proposed as a new variety or species.
A. Lau曾在Nuevo León州Bustamante西部的Gomas山脉收集到一棵植株，它有着不同寻常的宽叶子（宽达4cm），更进一步的研究可能会提出这是一个新的变种乃至物种。A form with red margins from Coahuila :

Echeveria subalpina 浮岳莲 - 千种多肉植物图鉴 - 梦桑阁


  
 Echeveria subalpina 浮岳莲
       "subalpina"这个词的意思是"亚高山生长"的，带入属名后意思是这个物种是在亚高山处生长的石莲花。故拟中文名"浮岳莲"。（玩过怪物猎人的盆友你懂的……）
原文地址：http://www.crassulaceae.ch/index.php?TPL=113&x270_id=1113&x270_listsearch=1
翻译：种花小医杂家赵
一切权利属于原作者，转载请注名原文链接及译者，欢迎勘误。SUBALPINA Rose & Purpus, 1910
浮岳莲 由Rose 和 Purpus发表于 1910年
Synonyms :
异名：
Echeveria akontiophylla  Werdermann (1932)
Echeveria meyraniana  E. Walther (1959)Series Secundae
七福神系Distribution : Mexico (Puebla, Tlaxcala, Veracruz)
分布地：墨西哥（普埃布拉州，特拉斯卡拉，韦拉克鲁斯）Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :
形态描述(gju 2003版本IHSP)：Stem  < 4 cm tall, rarely branching.
茎<4厘米高，很少分枝。Rosette  4 – 10 cm in diameter.
莲座直径4到10厘米。Leaves oblanceolate to linear-oblanceolate, long-acuminate, cuspidate, 2.5 – 5 (-14) x 1 – 1.5 cm, glaucous-green, mucro reddish.
叶倒披针形至线状披针形，长尖形。叶尖骤然变尖，2.5 - 5厘米长（-14厘米）×1 - 1.5厘米狂，叶有白霜，绿色，叶尖红色。Inflorescence a single or 2- branched cincinnus, to 30 cm long, pedicels 4 – 8 (-22) mm.
花序单支或2 分支蝎尾状花序，30厘米长，花梗4 - 8（-22）毫米。Flowers : Sepals widely spreading, corolla 10 – 12 x 6 – 8 mm in diameter near the base, orange to red, petals margins yellow.
花：萼片外展。花冠10 - 12毫米长，基部约6 - 8毫米直径，橙色至红色，花瓣边缘黄色。Cytology : n = 34
细胞学检查：染色体数=34The collection from Tlaxcala (Mun. Temezontly, Cerro Cuatlapangas) has smaller leaves and more caespitose rosettes.
从 Tlaxcala （Mun. Temezontly，Cerro Cuatlapangas）处收集的个体有较为短小的叶片，植物丛生。Note :
注意：
Very often the hybrid E. 'Olivine' is distributed under the name of this species.
一个叫做E. 'Olivine'的杂交石莲花常常被冠以Echeveria subalpina 的名字。
E. subalpina Perote, Puebla, Mexico.Photos Margrit Bischofberger以下来自google 搜索

segments.t:
Echeveria subrigida 刚叶莲、钢叶莲 - 千种多肉植物图鉴 - 梦桑阁


  
 Echeveria subrigida 刚叶莲、钢叶莲
       原文：http://www.crassulaceae.ch/index.php?TPL=10122&x270_id=430
翻译：Qiuhan转载请注明原文链接和译者。译者不懂植物学，欢迎勘误。
Echeveria subrigida 刚叶莲Synonyms :
异名：Cotyledon subrigida Robinson & Seaton (1893)
Echeveria palmeri Rose (1903)
Echeveria rosei Nelson & Macbride (1913)
Echeveria angusta  von Poellnitz (1936)
Series  Gibbiflorae
Gibbiflorae系
Distribution : Mexico (México, Hidalgo, San Luis Potosí, Guanajuato, Querétaro)
分布于墨西哥的México州、Hidalgo州、San Luis Potosí州、Guanajuato州、和Querétaro州Description (according to IHSP 2003) :
描述（根据2003年IHSP）：
Stem usually < 5 cm tall, to 5 cm in diameter, rarely branching.
茎部：通常不超过5cm高，较大直径5cm，很少分枝。
Rosette 15 – 20 cm in diameter.
莲座直径约15-20cm。
Leaves  oblong-oblanceolate, acute or shortly acuminate, 15 – 25 x 5 – 10 cm, thick, rigid, margins somewhat upturned and often finely undulate-crenulate, white-pruinose, sometimes nearly or entirely green, margin and mucro reddened.
叶：椭圆形或倒披针形，叶尖处陡然变窄；15-25cm长，2-10cm宽，厚实，坚硬；叶缘略微上翘，而且带有一丝微妙的褶边和细圆齿；被白霜，有时近乎于或完全是绿色的，叶缘和叶尖发红。
Inflorescences 1 - 2, narrowly cymose-paniculate, to 1 m tall, ±  15 mm in diameter near base, to 12-branched, each branch with 1 – 7 flowers, pedicels stout, 2 - 5 mm.
花序：1-2支，稀疏的圆锥聚散花絮，较高1m，基部直径15mm左右，较多12根分枝，每支约1-7朵花；花梗短粗，2-5mm长。
Flowers : Sepals ascending, to 25 mm, corolla urceolate, pentagonal, to 25 mm long, 14 mm in diameter or more near the base, ± 20 mm in diameter at the tip, glaucous, pink to scarlet, nectar scales scarlet.
花：花萼上翘，约25mm；翁状花冠，五角形，约25mm长，14mm直径，基部直径可能更大，顶部直径20mm左右；被霜；粉色或猩红色；蜜腺鳞片（？）猩红色。
Cytology : n = 27, 54
染色体：n=27,54。Note :
请注意：
Until its description in 1997 Echeveria cante erroneously has been distributed as E. subrigida. This means that hybrids with E. subrigida as one parent created prior to 1997 in fact are hybrids with E. cante.
直到1997年，拟石莲属广寒宫一直被误当做拟石莲属刚叶莲。这意味着1997年以前所有以刚叶莲为亲本之一的杂交品种实际上都是广寒宫的后代。

Echeveria tencho 天珠莲 - 千种多肉植物图鉴 - 梦桑阁


  
 Echeveria tencho 天珠莲
       很遗憾译者没有好用的拉丁词汇辞典，种加词tencho找不到其含义。谷歌翻译告诉我这个词的意思是"天诛"——应该是日语的罗马音形式，估计和这个植物没啥关系……真是宿命多舛，于是用音译的方法，拟中文名为"天珠莲"。原文：http://www.crassulaceae.ch/index.php?TPL=10122&x270_id=1935
翻译：种花小医杂家赵一切权利属于英文原作者，转载请注明原文链接和译者。欢迎勘误。
TENCHO Moran & Uhl, 2005
天珠莲 由Moran和Uhl发表于2005年Series Spicatae
穗状花序系Distribution : Mexico (Veracruz)
分布：墨西哥（韦拉克鲁斯）Description (according to Haseltonia 11, 2005) :
描述（按2005版 haseltonia 11期）：Plant shrubby, caudex branching, to 50 cm tall or more, 8 – 15 mm thick, pale green and glaucous above, darker below, leaf scars lenticular.
植株灌木型，茎多分枝，可长至50厘米高或更高，茎干8到15毫米粗，淡绿色，有白霜，近根处色深暗，叶痕呈双凸形。Rosette terminal, rather diffuse, 7 – 12 cm wide.
莲座顶生，较松散，7到12厘米宽。Leaves 12 – 25, oblanceolate, broadly acute and submucronate, 5 – 6.5 cm long, 15 – 22 mm wide above, 6 mm wide at base, 3 – 4 mm thick, at first ventrally channeled but later flattish, somewhat glaucous when young, later green or becoming reddish.
叶数12–25片，倒披针形，宽大有尖，叶下有棘，5–6.5厘米长，宽约15–22毫米以上，在叶基部6毫米宽，3–4毫米厚。近叶尖处有浅沟，渐移行平坦，嫩叶稍有白霜，成熟后成为绿色或红色。Inflorescences 1 – 3, to 50 cm tall, with 15 – 50 bracts, ascending at base but outcurved, elliptic to oblanceolate, broadly acute, spurred, up to 2.5 – 4 cm x 11 – 17 mm and to 3 mm thick, green, glaucous; racemes 7 – 20 cm long, with 25 – 40 flowers, rarely with a 2-flowered branch; pedicels 2 – 3 mm long.
花序：1–3枝，可达50厘米高，附着约15–50片小叶，在花序的基部向外上方弧形生长，椭圆形到倒披针形，宽尖型，有小刺，较大约2.5–4厘米长×11–17毫米宽，3毫米厚。绿色，有白霜；总状花序7–20厘米长，25–40朵花，稀见花序分支；花梗长3毫米。Flowers : Sepals widely spreading, unequal, triangular-lanceolate, acuminate, 6 – 12 mm  x 2 – 4 mm, corolla 13 – 15 mm long, 6 – 7 mm thick at base, 9 – 11 mm thick above, light yellow somewhat tinged with rose on apical half, petals slightly divergent, not in contact in upper two-thirds, triangular-lanceolate.
花：萼片平展，不等长，三角形披针形，渐尖，6–12毫米长×2–4毫米宽，花冠13–15毫米长，在基部厚6–7毫米，上部约9–11毫米厚，淡黄色，有些顶端呈玫红色。花开放不完全，打开约花瓣全长的三分之二，花瓣呈三角状披针形的。Cytology : n = 51
细胞学：染色体数=51Plants in habitat :

 Echeveria tobarensis 拓跋莲
       原文：ICN新站，Echeveria目录，Species子目录，TOBARENSIS条目
翻译：Qiuhan
一切权利属于英文原作者，转载请注明原文链接和译者。欢迎勘误。
Echeveria tobarensis A. Berger 1930
拓跋莲，由Berger发表于1930年
（中文名"拓跋莲"由@种花小医杂家赵 和Qiuhan根据音似而拟定）Synonym : Urbinia lurida Rose (1911)
异名：Urbinia lurida Rose (1911)（译者注：根据ICN旧站信息，拓跋莲应属瓮花系。）Distribution : Mexico (Durango)
分布于：墨西哥DurangoDescription (according to IHSP, 2003) :
描述（根据IHSP，2003）：Stem short (?)
短茎（？）Rosette 6 – 8 cm in diameter.
莲座6-8cm直径Leaves densely rosulate, ovate, acuminate, glabrous, 3 – 4 x 1,5 – 2,5 cm, very thick, purple or reddish.
叶子呈紧密的莲座状分布，卵形，锐尖，表面光洁，3-4cm长，1.5-2.5cm宽，很厚，紫色或淡红色。Inflorescence of 2 cincinni, 25 cm long.
花序2根，25cm长。Flowers: Sepals small, ovate, acute, corolla 6 – 7 mm long, dark red.
花：萼片小，卵形，有尖；花冠6-7mm长，暗红色。
This uncultivated species is known only from the type collection. Two attempts to re-collect it at the type locality were unsuccessful.
这个物种尚未被人工培育，只在样本栖息地被发现过。两次有人试图再赴栖息地采集，均失败了。
译注：但目前拓跋莲的种子kk已经有售，国内亦可买到，尚不知kk的种子来源，期待有人带大。

 Echeveria tolimanensis 杜里万莲
       原文：http://www.crassulaceae.ch/index.php?TPL=10122&x270_id=1890
翻译：Qiuhan
一切权利属于英文原作者，转载请注明原文链接和译者。译者不懂植物学，欢迎勘误。
Echeveria tolimanensis Matuda, 1958
杜里万莲，由Matuda发表于1958年Series Urbiniae
瓮花系
Distribution : Mexico (Hidalgo)
分布于墨西哥的Hidalgo州
Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :
描述（根据2003年IHSP）：Stem less than 5 cm long, 1 – 2.5 cm in diameter, rarely branching.
茎部：长度小于5cm，1-2.5cm直径，很少分枝。Leaves rosulate, narrowly lanceolate to linear-oblong, semiterete, upper face somewhat flattened, aristate, 4 – 9 x 1.5 – 2 cm, 8 – 13 mm in diameter, lightly pruinose, greenish-white.
叶：莲座状排列；窄的披针形到线形-椭圆形，半圆柱状，上表面较为扁平，顶端有芒，4-9cm长，1.5-2cm宽，8-13mm直径；略带白霜，淡绿色-白色。Inflorescence with 2 – 3 cincinni, 10 – 12 cm long, racemes 2 – 3, pendent, pedicels slender, 6 – 17 mm.
花序：上有2-3根蝎尾状分枝，10-12cm长，总状花序2-3根，悬垂状，花梗纤细，6-17mm。Flowers : Sepals spreading to reflexed, corolla terete-urceolate, 10 – 14 mm long, coral-pink below, orange above.
花：萼片张开或向后弯折；花冠圆柱形-瓮形，10-14mm长，底部珊瑚粉色，顶部橙色。Cytology : n = 30

Echeveria uhlii 青岫莲 - 千种多肉植物图鉴 - 梦桑阁


  
 Echeveria uhlii 青岫莲
       [翻译] Echeveria uhlii 种名是为了纪念植物学家Uhl博士，他命名了很多景天科植物，也是一名景天育种者。E.uhlii株型优美，叶色青翠，色可媲美岫玉，故拟名"青岫（xiù）莲"。它可以说是拟石莲属中长得较像山地玫瑰的物种了，真挺"清秀"的~哈哈…原文：http://www.crassulaceae.ch/index.php?TPL=10122&x270_id=1976
翻译：种花小医杂家赵一切权利属于英文原作者，转载请注明原文链接和译者。欢迎勘误。UHLII Meyrán, 1992
由Meyrán发表于1992年Series Racemosae
总状花序系Distribution : Mexico (Oaxaca : North of Tamazulapan, near Xochixtlahuaca)
分布：墨西哥（瓦哈卡州，Tamazulapan以北，靠近Xochixtlahuaca） Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :
 说明形态描述（根据IHSP，2003年）; Stem < 5 cm long, ± 7 mm in diameter, conspicuously covered with dry leaves.
茎干小于5厘米长，直径7毫米上下，明显覆盖着干枯的叶子。 Rosette 4 – 6 cm in diameter.
 莲座4 - 6厘米直径。 Leaves 30 – 40, obovate to spatulate, subacute to obtuse, mucronate, 1,7 – 2,5 x 1 – 1,5 cm, green, slightly pruinose.
叶数30 - 40片，倒卵形至匙形，锐尖到钝园型，有尖，1.7 - 2.5长，1 - 1.5厘米宽，绿色，略带粉霜。 Inflorescences : Racemes 4 – 15 cm long, pedicels pendent from the lower side of the inflorescence, 4 – 14 mm.
 花序：总状花序，4 - 15厘米长，花梗低垂，4-14毫米长Flowers : Sepals nearly equal, slightly ascending, ovate, corolla pentagonal, 7 – 9 x 4 – 7 mm in diameter, reddish yellow.
花：萼片近相等，稍微上翘，卵形，花冠五边形。7 - 9×4 -7 毫米直径，花黄色稍红染。 Plant in habitat :

 Echeveria unguiculata 魔爪
       原文：http://www.crassulaceae.ch/index.php?TPL=10122&x270_id=1178
翻译：Qiuhan
一切权利属于英文原作者，转载请注明原文链接和译者，欢迎勘误。Echeveria unguiculata Kimnach, 2002
魔爪，由Kimnach发表于2002年Series Angulatae
剑司系

丛生，基部分头，可达20cm高以上，表面光洁。Stems branching mostly from base, suberect to semidecumbent, 10 – 12 cm thick near base, 5 – 10 mm thick near apex, prominently marked with elliptical, tan leaf-scars.

Greenovia aurea 黄金山地玫瑰深探 - 千种多肉植物图鉴 - 梦桑阁


  
 Greenovia aurea 黄金山地玫瑰深探
       Aeonium aureum (C.Sm. ex Hornem.) T.H.M.Mes
WCSP（World Checklist of Selected Plant Families）认可
常用名：Greenovia aurea
Greenovia aurea是Greenovia(山地玫瑰属)合并为Aeonium(莲花掌属)后确认的四个原始种之一,同时也是山地玫瑰中广为人知的品种.
该种广泛分布于加那利群岛的大加那利岛（GranCanaria）,特内里费岛（Tenerife）,耶罗岛（El Hierro）,戈梅拉岛（La Gomera）和拉帕尔马岛（La Palma）海拔1000- 1900m北坡针叶林区的岩缝隙中.
Greenovia植株直径约为20-25cm,叶子颜色常呈灰蓝,青色,在表面被有白粉.花期为5-7月,花色为奶黄色,花后有大量的种子,而且侧芽生长十分迅速,因此繁殖方式主要为侧芽和种子.
黄金山地应该是山地玫瑰种较具有代表性的品种,其在夏季休眠时所呈现出的玫瑰状态更是山地玫瑰系受到欢迎的原因之一.
AUREUM (C.Smith ex Hornemann) Mes, 1995 黄金山地
Synonyms :
异名:
Sempervivum aureum C.Smith ex Hornemann (1819) / Greenovia aurea  (C.Smith ex Hornemann) Webb & Berthelot (1840)
Sempervivum calyciforme  Haworth (1819)
Greenovia ferrea Webb in Christ (1888) / Sempervivum ferreum  (Webb) Christ (1888)
Greenovia polypharmica Webb in Christ (1888) / Sempervivum polypharmicum (Webb) Christ (1888)
Greenovia rupifraga  Webb in Christ (1888) / Sempervivum rupifragum  (Webb) Christ (1888)
Section Greenovia
山地玫瑰组
Distribution : Canary Islands (Gran Canaria, Tenerife, Gomera, La Palma, Hierro); 400 - 2000 m.
分布:加那利群岛(大加那利岛,特内里费岛,戈梅拉岛,拉帕玛岛,耶罗岛);400 - 2000m地区.
Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :
描述(根据IHSP,2003):
Monocarpic perennials.
(花后死亡)多年生植物.
Rosette solitary or occasionally offsetting, 8 - 25 cm, cup-shaped with the inner leaves erect, tightly closed during the dry season.
莲座状叶,植株单生,偶尔有侧芽,植株8 - 26cm,呈杯形,内叶直立,在旱季紧闭.
Leaves 5 - 11 x 3 - 6 cm, obovate-spatulate, apically rounded, truncate or broadly cuneate, minutely apiculate or retuse, basally broadly cuneate, glabrous, glaucous, margin hyaline and occasionally with some minute glandular hairs, pale green.
叶长5 - 11cm宽3 - 6cm,倒卵状匙形,先端圆形,截形或宽楔形,有微小的细尖或微凹,基部宽楔形.叶无毛,有白霜,边缘透明,某些情况下会有腺毛,淡绿色.
Inflorescences flat-topped, 10 - 25 x 20 - 45 cm, peduncle 15 - 35 cm, densely leafy, pedicels 2 - 5 mm, pubescent.
平顶花序,长10 - 25cm,宽20 - 45cm,总花梗15 - 35cm,密被叶状,花梗2 - 5mm,被柔毛.
Flowers 25- to 32-merous, sepals puberulent or pubescent, petals 7 – 8 x 1.5 - 2 mm, oblanceolate, acuminate, often apiculate, deep yellow, filaments glabrous.
花基数25 - 32,花萼被微柔毛或短柔毛,花瓣长7 - 8mm,宽1.5 - 2mm,倒披针形,渐尖,先端尖,深黄,花丝无毛.

Greenovia diplocycla 冷霜 - 千种多肉植物图鉴 - 梦桑阁


  
 Greenovia diplocycla 冷霜
       Aeonium diplocyclum (Webb ex Bolle) T.H.M.Mes
WCSP（World Checklist of Selected Plant Families）认可
常用名：Greenovia diplocycla
Grenovia diplocycla是Greenovia(山地玫瑰属)合并为Aeonium(莲花掌属)后确认的四个原始种之一,同时也是山地玫瑰中休眠状态较可爱的品种.
该品种主要分布于加那利群岛的特内里费岛（Tenerife）,戈梅拉岛（La Gomera）和拉帕尔马岛（La Palma）海拔50-1700m的岩石峭壁之上.
Greenovia diplocycla是Grenovia原始种中较大的,直径能够达到15-20cm,圆润可爱的青绿叶片被有白霜,该种和Grenovia aurea很相似,但它并不像前者一样喜欢长出侧芽,因此它的主要繁殖方式就是种子繁殖.
DIPLOCYCLUM (Webb ex Bolle) Mes, 1995 冷霜
Synonyms :
异名:
Greenovia diplocyclaWebb ex Bolle (1859) / Sempervivum diplocyclum(Webb ex Bolle) Christ (1888)
Section Greenovia
山地玫瑰组
Distribution : Canary Islands (Gomera, La Palma, Hierro);海拔 50 - 1700 m.
分布:加那利群岛(戈梅拉岛.拉帕尔马岛,耶罗岛);50 - 1700m地区.
Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :
描述(根据IHSP,2003):
Perennial solitary monocarpic rosettes 6 - 18 cm in diameter, cup-shaped with inner leaves erect, tightly closed during the dry season.
多年生植物,独生,莲座状叶直径6 - 18cm,植株杯形,内叶直立,在夏季叶片闭合.
Leaves 5 - 8 x 4 - 6.5 cm, obovate-spatulate, apically rounded, truncate or broadly cuneate, apiculate or rarely retuse, basally broadly cuneate, glabrous, glaucous, margin hyaline, occasionally sparsely glandular-hairy, often minutely erose or sinuate, pale green.
叶片长5 - 8cm,宽4 - 6.5cm,倒卵状匙形,先端圆形,截形或宽楔形,偶尔具细尖或微凹,基部宽楔形,无毛,有白霜,边缘透明,偶有稀疏腺毛,叶缘往往呈微小的啮蚀状或波状,淡绿色。
Inflorescences flat-topped, floriferous part 13 - 16 x 15 - 20 cm, peduncle 8 - 22 cm, densely leafy, pedicels 2 - 4 mm, glandular-hairy.
平顶状花序,多花部分高13 - 15cm,宽15 - 20cm,总花梗8长 - 22cm,密被叶状,花梗长2 - 4mm,有腺毛.
Flowers 19- to 24-merous, sepals glandular-hairy, petals 5 - 6 x 1 - 1.5mm, lanceolate, acuminate, often apiculate, deep yellow, filaments glabrous.
花基数19 - 24,萼片被腺毛,花瓣长5 - 6mm,宽1 - 1.5mm,披针形,渐尖,常具细尖,深黄,花丝无毛.
Hardly different from A. aureum - this species group (including A. dodrantale) is not yet satisfactorily resolved.
与Aeonium aureum几乎没有不同,(P.S.其实较大的不同就是大小还有是否出侧芽,Aeonium aureum是会出侧芽的品种.)

Grenovia diplocycla in summer
©Zusung

Grenovia diplocycla from La Gomera
©Zusung
上图是较经典的图片,出自Zusung之手,可以看到同一种之间由于地域隔离产生的独立特征还是很不一样的,值得收集.与其它地区的Grenovia diplocycla不同的是戈梅拉岛(La Gomera)的Grenovia diplocycla老叶在特定的情况下会泛红.

Plants at La Palma after a very dry summer. 
拉帕尔马岛的植株,在干旱的夏季之后.
Photo Carolina Carbonell Launois相对于Grenovia diplocycla来说,似乎它的园艺变种Greenovia diplocycla var. gigantea更加受欢迎,因为它更近乎于卵形的休眠期模样,实在是勾魂.

Greenovia diplocycla 'Gigantea'
©Zusung

Greenovia diplocycla var. gigantea
©Kelley Macdonald
©fraying接下来仍然是Greenovia diplocycla
©anniesannuals
©thehumofbees

野外状态下的Greenovia diplocycla (产地未知)
©Universität Göttinge

Greenovia diplocycla 较后的绽放
©allloe
和别的Greenovia相同,Greenovia diplocycla 将耗尽生命绽放出灿烂的花朵,然而它并没有留下侧芽.也就是说,这使得它更要耐人寻味.每一株Greenovia diplocycla 都是独一无二,它盛开它死去,便完全消失在世界上.这点,使得我这个和它相同的人类有了一种难以言说的复杂感受.资料引用自:Google & Flickr & The Plant List & International Crassulaceae Network

TEXANUM (J.G.Smith) J.N.Rose, 1904 (engl./ fr.)Synonyms :
异名Sedum texanum  J.G.Smith (1895) / Villadia texana  (J.G.Smith) Rose (1903)
Lenophyllum pusillum  Rose (1905)Distribution : USA (S Texas), NE Mexico; below 100 m.
地理分布：美国（德克萨斯州南部），墨西哥东北部；海拔100米以下Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :
描述：（根据2003年IHSP）Plants 10 – 40 cm tall, green becoming reddish.
植株10-40厘米高，颜色由绿变红。Leaves ovate-lanceolate to elliptic to oblanceolate, acuminate, 1 – 2.5 x 0.4 – 1 cm.
叶卵状-披针形到椭圆形到倒披针形，渐尖，1-2.5 x 0.4-1厘米。Inflorescences racemes or spikes or narrow thyrses, 2 – 15 x 1.2 – 2 cm, with 5 – 25 commonly 1-flowered branches.
花序为总状花序或穗状花序或狭窄的聚伞圆锥花序，2-15 x 1.2-2厘米，每支花枝通常开5-25朵。Flowers : Sepals acute to acuminate, corolla buffy or dull yellow, often marked with red.

注意：In the greenhouse this plant can become very invasive, and nurseries consider it a pest. Leaves and bracts detach and root easily and produce multitudes of new plantlets.

Prometheum typhaeum 点滴莲 - 千种多肉植物图鉴 - 梦桑阁


  
 Prometheum typhaeum 点滴莲
       TYMPHAEUM (Quézel & Contandriopoulos) 't Hart, 1995 点滴莲
Synonym :
异名:
Sedum thymphaeum Quézel & Constandriopoulos (1967)
Distribution : Nothern Greece; mountains, on rocks in crevices, limestone, 2000 – 2200 m, rare endemic and only known from 3 or 4 mountain tops.
Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :
Perennials, densely covered with minute glandular hairs, sticky.
Rosette globose, forming offsets on short axillary stolons.
Leaves oblong-obovate to spatulate, flattened, 10 – 12 x 3 – 4 mm .
Inflorescence axillary, ascending or erect, 5 – 8 (-10) cm, generally as few-flowered corymbose cymes with 2 – 3, sometimes forked, cincinni, pedicels to 8 mm,
Flowers : Sepals basally slightly connate, oblong , 3 – 4 mm, petals 7 – 9 mm, basally conate, with broadly ovate-elliptic, acute, 3 – 4 mm wide , white or sometimes tinged with red, filaments white, anthers red, styles ± 1 mm, fruits stellate-patent, yellowish-brown, with distinct paler (whitish) lips along the sutures, seeds ovoid, brown.
Cytology : 2n = 14
Formely included in Sedum, but closely related to the monocarpic P. pilosum and P. sempervivoides.
The 3 species can be easily hybridized, but their hybrids are completely sterile ('t Hart & al. 1999).
分布:北希腊;山,岩石上的裂缝,石灰石,2000–2200米地区,十分稀有,且仅在3-4座山峰有分布.
描述(根据IHSP,2003):
多年生草本,密被小腺毛,有粘性.
莲座结形成球状,匍匐茎短腋生侧芽.
叶片长圆状倒卵形的到匙形,扁平,10–12 x 3–4毫米.
花序腋生,上升或直立,5–8(－10)厘米,通常是少花的伞房状聚伞花序2–3支.有时分叉,蝎尾状聚伞花序,花梗到8毫米长.
花:萼片长圆形.基部稍合生.3–4毫米.花瓣7–9毫米.基部合生,有时为宽卵形椭圆形,急尖,宽3–4毫米,白色或有时微染红色,花丝白色,花药红色,±1毫米,星状的种荚,黄棕色,有明显的苍白(白色)唇沿缝线,种子卵球形,棕色.
染色体:2n＝14
之前被分于景天属(Sedum)名下,但与一果植物P. pilosum ,P. sempervivoides有紧密的关系.
上述三种品种可以进行杂交,但杂交种完全不育.

 Sedum hirsutum 春上和姬春上
       来源:icn —— sedum属条目 —— Sedum hirsutum原始种条目翻译：种花小医杂家赵一切权利属于英文原作者，转载请注明原文链接和译者。欢迎勘误。
HIRSUTUM Allioni, 1785
春上 由Allioni发表于1785年Synonyms :
异名：
Leucosedum hirsutum (Allioni) Fourreau (1868) / Oreosedum hirsutum (Allioni) Grulich (1984) / Rosularia hirsuta (Allioni) Eggli (1988)
Sedum hirsutum var. rubellum Merino
Sedum hirsutum var. maroccanum  Font Quer (1928)
Sedum winkleri var. maroccanum  Font Quer (1928)
Sedum hirsutum var. gattefossei  Maire & al. ex Maire (1938)
Sedum hirsutum var. thermarum  Maire & al. ex Maire (1938)Distribution : SW Europe (Spain, Portugal, France, Italy), N Africa (Morocco).
分布：欧洲西南部（西班牙，葡萄牙，法国，意大利），北非（摩洛哥）Description (according to IHSP 2003) :
形态描述（根据2003版IHSP）Densely glandular-pubescent rosulate perennial herbs, usually forming tufts and propagating through axillary propagules consisting of a simple leaf-less thin stolon to 6 cm long with a terminal rooting rosette.
被有浓密腺状短柔毛的莲座状的多年生草本植物。通常成簇，通过细小、少叶的腋芽形成一个覆盖达6cm直径的群体的有根莲座。Leaves alternate, oblanceolate, obtuse, sessile, semiterete; flowering branches simple, erect, sparsely leafy, 5 – 12 (- 15) cm.
叶互生，倒披针形，钝，无柄，半圆柱形；花序简单，直立，几乎无花序叶，5–12（－15）厘米高。Inflorescences cymes with (1-) 2 (-3) cincinni, bracts 1 per flower, small, oblong, pedicels 3 – 6 mm.
花序：聚伞花序，有一到三个蝎尾状分支序，每花有一个苞片叶，小，长圆形，花梗3–6毫米长。Flowers 5-merous, sepals broadly sessile, slightly connate basally, oblong, acute, to 2.5 mm, petals basally slightly connate, spreading, white, anthers dark red.
花5瓣，萼片宽，无柄，基部稍合生，长圆形，急尖，2.5毫米长，花瓣基部稍合生，平展，花瓣白色，花药深红色。Two subspecies are accepted :
名下有两个被承认的亚种：Sedum hirsutum ssp. baeticum
春上Sedum hirsutum ssp. hirsutum
（无明确中文名，因植株体型小于春上，拟中文名"姬春上"）

HIRSUTUM ssp. BAETICUM Rouy, 1887
春上 由Rouy发表于1887年Synonyms :
异名：
Sedum hirsutum var. baeticum  (Rouy) Praeger (1918) / Oreosedum hirsutum ssp. baeticum  (Rouy) Velayos (1989)
Umbilicus winkleri  Willkomm (1883) / Cotyledon winkleri  (Willkomm) Pérez Lara (1891) / Sedum winkleri  (Willkomm) Wolley-Dod (1914) / Sedum hirsutum ssp. winkleri  (Willkomm) Font Quer (1928) / Oreosedum winkleri  (Willkomm) Grulich (1984)
Sedum hirsutum var. winkleri  Maire (1932)
Differs from ssp. hirsutum :
和姬春上的区别：Plants larger and more robust with stout stolons and
植株较大，有更加粗大的匍匐茎。Rosettes to 4 cm in diameter.
莲座可达4厘米直径。Leaves to 12 (-15) mm, sticky,
叶片12到15毫米长，有粘性。Flowers large, petals basally connate for 3 mm, broadly ovate, rounded with a short mucro, to 5 – 8 mm.
花朵较大， 花瓣基部愈合可达3毫米，宽卵形，花瓣圆形有短尖，5–8毫米长。Cytology : 2n=60
细胞学：二倍体染色体数=60

植物来自南非的Weltevrede Succulent苗圃

HIRSUTUM ssp. HIRSUTUM
姬春上Synonymes :
异名：
Sedum hirsutum var. jahandiezii  Maire (1932)
Sedum hirsutum ssp. eu-hirsutum  Maire (1932)Description :
形态描述：Plants usually small with thin stolons.
植物通常娇小，匍匐茎纤细。Rosettes 1 – 2 (-4) cm diameter.
莲座1-2厘米（较大可到4厘米）直径。Leaves 3 – 8 mm, not very sticky.
叶3 - 8毫米长，不是很粘。Inflorescences often lax and few-flowered.
花序通常排列松懈，着花较少。Flowers : Petals basally slightly connate (<1 mm), lanceolate, acute or acuminate, 3 – 6 mm.
花：花瓣基部稍愈合（<1毫米），花瓣披针形，急尖或渐尖，花瓣长度3 - 6毫米。Cytology : 2n=18, 20
细胞学：2倍体染色体数=18或者20Observation à / at : La Suche (municipality of / commune de St. Jeure d'Andaure) France - Ardèche, 800 m alt. (31.7.2004),
（这句不会翻译，法语英语混排……）between the roots of a chestnut tree / entre les racines d'un marronier.

Sedum versadense 春之奇迹/薄毛万年草 - 千种多肉植物图鉴 - 梦桑阁


  
 Sedum versadense 春之奇迹/薄毛万年草
       来源:icn —— sedum属条目 Sedum versadense原始种条目翻译：种花小医杂家赵一切权利属于英文原作者，转载请注明原文链接和译者。欢迎勘误。
VERSADENSE C. H. Thompson, 1911
春之奇迹/薄毛万年草  由 C. H.汤普森发表于 1911年Synonym : Sedum chontalense  Alexander (1947)
异名：Sedum chontalense  Alexander（ 1947年）Distribution : Mexico (Oaxaca)
分布：墨西哥（哈瓦卡州）Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :
形态描述（根据2003版本IHSP）：Perennial herbs or subshrubs with erect or decumbent hairy stems.
多年生草本或半灌木，有直立或匍匐的多毛茎干。Leaves alternate, obovate or spatulate, truncate or rounded, apiculate to emarginate, basally cuneate, subterete, ± hairy, green with red at the tip and margins, often flushed reddish or reddish-brown, 7 - 32 x 4 - 15 mm, flowering branches pendulous.
叶互生，倒卵形或匙形，截形或圆形，具细尖或叶尖部微凹陷，基部楔形，近圆柱状，有毛或者无毛，叶绿色，有红色的尖端和边缘，经常呈现微红或红褐色， 7 - 32毫米长， 4 - 16毫米宽，开花枝下垂。Inflorescences cymes, drooping in bud, bracts prominent, similar to the leaves of flowering branches, pedicels 2 - 3 mm.
花序：顶生聚伞花序，花苞下垂，苞片叶突出，类似于开花枝条的叶片，花梗2 - 3毫米。Flowers 5- (rarely 4- or 6-) merous, sepals broadly sessile, basally connate, very unequal, oblanceolate-elliptic or oblong, acute or abruptly apiculate, green, 5 - 8.1 x 2.2 - 3.6 mm, erect, petals basally slightly connate, oblanceolate-elliptic or elliptic, apiculate, pinkish-white, ± 5.5 mm, suberect, anthers red.
花：以5为 （稀见4  或6  ）基数，萼片阔无柄，基部合生，苞片大小差别很大，倒披针形，椭圆形或长圆形，急尖或突然收细的尖，绿色， 5 - 8.1长 ×2.2 - 3.6毫米宽，直立。花瓣基部稍合生，倒披针形，椭圆形或椭圆形，具细尖，粉白色花瓣， ±5.5毫米，近直立，花药红色。Cytology : 2n = 64, 128
细胞学检查：2倍体染色体数=64,128Two varieties :
名下有两个变种：Sedum versadense var. versadense
原变种：春之奇迹/薄毛万年草Sedum versadense var. villadioides  Kimnach, 1982
和1982年发表的长叶薄毛万年草
VERSADENSE var. VERSADENSE
薄毛万年草/春之奇迹Distribution : Mexico (Oaxaca: Sierra Madre del Sur, Southern Trans-Mexican Volcanic Belt); ± 1800 m.
分布：墨西哥（瓦哈卡州：马德雷德尔苏尔，南部横贯墨西哥火山带），±1800米海拔区域。Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :
形态描述：（根据2003版IHSP）Leaves broadly cuneate-oblanceolate, 14 - 27 x 8.5 - 14.6 mm, 4 mm thick ,both faces shortly hairy with thin hairs, upper face reddish-cream, lower face dark brownish-red.
叶宽楔形倒披针形，14-27毫米长 X 8.5 - 14.6毫米宽，约4毫米厚，叶片双面都密布短绒毛，叶正面浅红色，叶背面暗棕红色。Plant in habitat in Oaxaca :
哈瓦卡州原生地植株：
Photos © Ralph Mangelsdorff
Photos Gerhard Köhres

园艺栽培，右侧为长叶薄毛万年草:
Photos Michael Wisnev网络搜索图片：

VERSADENSE var. VILLADIOIDES Kimnach, 1982
长叶薄毛万年草 由Kimnach发表于1982年。Distribution : Mexico (Oaxaca)
分布：墨西哥（哈瓦卡州）Differs from var. versadense :
与薄毛万年草的区别：Leaves linear-oblanceolate, ± 10 x 3 mm, 2 mm thick, upper face glabrous, lower face shortly hairy with shorther and thicker hairs, both faces faintly reddish-yellow.
叶长披针形，±10×3毫米，厚2毫米，叶的上表面无毛，下表面被毛，毛比薄毛万年草要粗短，叶的两面都呈现淡淡的红黄色。

Tacitus bellus美丽莲/别露珠 - 千种多肉植物图鉴 - 梦桑阁


  
 Tacitus bellus美丽莲/别露珠
       一切权力属于原英文作者，译者不懂植物学，欢迎指正
转载请注明原作者&译者。原文：ICN
译者：柳下杜拉罕
BELLUS Moran & Meyrán, 1974 (engl./ fr.)Distribution : Mexico (Chihuahua), east-exposed rocks, 1600 m.
分布：墨西哥（奇瓦瓦州），东部裸露的岩石，海拔1600米。Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :
描述（根据2003年IHSP）：Rosette plants, main root thickened, to 4 mm in diameter.
莲座状植物，主根增粗，直径4毫米。Stems short.
茎短。Rosette flat and densely leafy, 3 – 8 cm in diameter, with ± 25 – 30 leaves, solitary or forming groups.
莲座平坦浓密，直径3-8厘米，有±25-30片叶片，单生或群生。Leaves obovate to cuneate, broadly obtuse to rounded, 2 – 3.5 x 1.5 – 2-8 cm, 4 – 5 mm thick, mostly dark or grayish-green, mucro 2 mm and somewhat papillose.
叶片倒卵形的到楔形，宽钝到圆形，2-3.5 x 1.5-2.8厘米，4-5毫米厚，主要w为黑或灰绿色，2毫米，稍具小乳突尖。Inflorescences erect thyrses with 1 – 4 ascending scorpioid branches with up to 3 flowers each, scape 1.5 – 3.5 cm, green, pedicels 10 – 25 mm.
花序直立聚伞圆锥花序具1–4上升分枝，每个分枝多达3朵花，花葶1.5-3.5厘米，绿色，花梗10-25毫米。Flowers (rarely 4- or) 5 merous, (almost) unscented, sepals elliptic to oblong, acute, almost equal, recurved towards the end of the anthesis, 6 – 11 x 2 – 4 mm, pale green, corolla (23-) 30 – 38 mm in diameter, petals elliptic-acute, ± deep rose-coloured, tube cup-shaped, 3 – 4 x 4 – 6 mm, lobes elliptic-ovate, acute, margins entire or finely denticulate in the middle, 11 – 18 x 6 – 10 mm, without pattern, basally with 2 rounded outgrowths that close the mouth of the tube and embrace the epipetal filaments,filaments 7 – 11 mm, basally fused with the corolla tube for 3 – 4 mm, rose-coloured.
花（很少4或）5瓣，（几乎）无迹，萼片椭圆形到长圆形，急性，几乎相等，花期结束时下弯，6-11 x 2-4毫米，淡绿色，花冠直径（23-）30-38毫米，花瓣椭圆形急性，±深玫瑰色，管杯状，3–4 x 4–6毫米，裂片椭圆状卵形，急性，边缘全缘或具小齿在中间，11–18 x 6–10毫米，没有花纹，基部具2圆形突起，封闭管口， 包住花丝，花丝7–11毫米合生，基部与花冠筒3–4毫米，玫瑰色。Cytology : n = ± 204
染色体：n =±204Discovery of Tacitus bellus by Alfred Lau
艾尔弗雷德先生发现美丽莲"This plant I discovered years ago and I brought it home thinking it might have been a Graptopetalum; potted it and put it to one side and temporarily forgot about it, until one day my son Alfred asked me to come to the greenhouse to see the lovely flower; when I got there I found that it was not a Graptopetalum but a new plant altogether.
"这是我多年前就发现的，我把它带回家并认为是风车草；盆栽放在一边，暂时忘记了它，直到有一天，我的儿子艾尔弗雷德要我到温室去看可爱的花；我到那儿时，我发现这不是一个风车草属，是一种全新的植物。A little later, I took it to Mexico City to Dr. Bravo at the University there. She was so excited about it that she immediately phoned Dr. Meyrán asking him to come as soon as possible with his best camera. Later it was published under its present name Tacitus bellus, and has been called the succulent of the seventies, and my first plant discovery.
一段时间以后，我就去墨西哥市的大学找到布拉沃博士。她对此十分激动以至于她马上打电话给Meyrán博士并要他尽快带着他较好的相机来。后来它改名为Tacitus bellus发布，被称作是七十年代的多肉，我第一个发现的植物。It came out on several calendars and is used in Germany as a Mothers' Day plant. It is very easy to propagate and each leaf, when detached, produces 1-2 or even 3 new plants. When I found it in 1972 I brought back 3 plants and now there are millions in the world."
它被印在几个日历上并在德国作为一种母亲节用花。它非常容易通过每一片叶子繁殖，当叶片与母体分离后会产生1-2个甚至3个新植株。
我1972年发现并带回的3棵现在在全世界已经有数以百万计的种苗。"This was a part of A. Lau's talk at the Convention CSS in Melbourne in June 1982,published in 'The Spine' Vol. 30 No. 3 June 1982.
这是A. Lau与 1982年六月在墨尔本公约CSS讲话的一部分，于1982年六月发表在'The Spine'30卷3号。Note :A seedling from Tacitus bellus is wrongly called Tacitus bellus 'Superstar'. This name is not correct, because the plant is a hybrid, possibly with Graptopetalum rusbyi and therefore it has to be called xTacipetalum 'Superstar'.
注：美丽莲被错误地称为Tacitus bellus 'Superstar'。这个名称是不正确的，因为植物是一种杂交，可能与银天女有亲缘关系，因此也被称为xTacipetalum 'Superstar'.。
Photo Paul Neut
Photos Noelene Tomlinson

 c 卡罗拉杂交后代
       资料来源ICN，由种花小医杂家赵收集整理翻译，转载请注明泛景主题站及译者。卡罗拉在自然界也存在类似七福神的光谱现象，各个分布地的种群存在渐变差异，从分类学角度上将两种极端的形态赋予变型地位。
两个变型即：
圆叶的卡罗拉（即林赛）Echeveria colorata f. colorata   泛景站内地址：http://funjing.com/forum.php?mod ... ;highlight=colorata
尖叶的勃兰特 Echeveria colorata f. brandtiii  泛景站内地址：http://funjing.com/forum.php?mod ... ;highlight=colorata其中卡罗拉（林赛）作为亲本在园艺种培育中大放异彩，本文介绍几种常见的卡罗拉杂交后代。

elegans 'Albicans' x colorata 'Lindsayana' 
未正式定名，亲本为：厚叶月影*卡罗拉
E. albicans x lindsayana - the original name of this hybrid - has been created by Bob Grim, California.
As the hybrid is known world-wide it seems likely that other breeders have made the same crossing. The hybrid resembles much more E. elegans than E. colorata.
亲本组合即它的原始名字，由加州的Bob Grim育成。这个杂交种世界知名，似乎其他的育种者也尝试了与之相同的杂交组合。这个杂交种更加像它的亲本厚叶月影多一些。

Parentage : Echeveria chihuahuaensis 吉娃娃x E. colorata 'Lindsayana' 卡罗拉培育人不详.
In Korea this hybrid is called "Chihuahualindsa" - according to the Code not a valid name.
在韩国这个杂交种被叫做 "Chihuahualindsa" ，不符合命名原则。In Europe this hybrid is distributed with the wrong name 'Tippy', but it can easily be told apart from the correct 'Tippy'- the rosette of the latter is much paler, the leaf shape is different and the flowers are by far not the same.
在欧洲这个品种被误标为蒂比，其实很容易分辨出真正的蒂比，蒂比的植株显得更加苍白一些。叶形和花也有很大差别。Without flowers this hybrid is indistinguishable from E. chihuahuaensis and also the flowers are only little different from those of the species. It should better not have been created - it is only confusing.
除了花以外，这个杂交种和吉娃娃几乎难以区分，且花也仅与吉娃娃有微小不同。这个品种只给人带来困惑，也许根本不该培育出来。

由英国约克郡希普利地区的Albert Baynes培育成功Parentage: Graptopetalum paraguayense x Echeveria gibbiflora hort.
亲本：风车草属胧月x 拟石莲属粉彩莲某园艺种
(译著：即 xGraptoveria 风车石莲)Synonyms \ 异名: Graptopetalum ivesii hort., Echeveria ivesii hort., Graptoveria ivesii hort., Echeveria gibbiflora hort. non DC, Echeveria 'Spring Morning', xGraptoveria 'Spring Morning'.First published by J. C. Van Keppel in Succulenta 58 (10) : 251-253,1979 and named for Fred Ives of Shipley, Yorkshire.
1979年首次出现在Van Keppel出版的《Succulenta 58》上，命名以纪念约克郡希普利地区一位叫Fred Ives的人物。Description: "Caulescent, with a few-leaved, short rosette at the top; stem to 3 cm in diameter, green, flushed blue-grey, later brown and with pronounced leaf scars; rosette 30-40 cm in diameter; leaves glabrous, obovate-oblanceolate, +- 15 cm long, +- 6 cm wide in the upper half, 0.4 cm thick, often with an oblique mucro; upperside concave, backside convex, faintly keeled, tip curved down; colour green, flushed strongly bluish, in full sun turning to pinkish; inflorescence racemose with many long cincinnate axes, each with 5 – 15 yellowish flowers; flower stalks with many large bracts, which stay till after flowering; sepals long, unequal in size." (Van Keppel in Nat. Cact. & Succ. J., Vol. 36/1, 1981 )
描述："有茎品种；莲座叶片疏落，着生于茎顶部；茎干直径至3厘米，绿杂蓝灰，之后棕变，遍布叶根残印；莲座直径30~40厘米；叶片无毛，倒卵披针形，约15厘米长，远端约6厘米宽，0.4厘米厚，常具斜短叶尖；叶上表面凹，背面凸，依稀龙骨痕迹，行至叶尖转而下；叶片基色绿，染醒目偏蓝光泽，全日照即转粉红；总状花序，抽生若干倒蝎尾花轴，每分支5 ​~15朵花，色黄；花茎着生大型苞片多个，花期后仍伫留；萼片长，大小不均。" (Van Keppel in Nat. Cact. & Succ. J., Vol. 36/1, 1981 )
Albert Baynes had indicated that the Echeveria-parent was E. gibbiflora. Van Keppel disagreed, because he knew that E. gibbiflora was not in cultivation in the UK at that time, but he also thought that a plant of the gibbiflora-complex was involved in this crossing.
培育者Albert Baynes表示，亲本之一为粉彩莲。Van Keppel持反对，因当时粉彩莲未在英国引种；但他也认为粉彩莲系的某交配种为其血亲。
